title: FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Dataset and Cosmological Inference Competition
background_knowledge: 弱引力透镜是宇宙学中直接探测物质分布的重要探针：前景大尺度结构使背景星系图像发生微弱而相干的形状畸变，其统计特征可由剪切场 $\gamma$ 与收敛场 $\kappa$ 描述。通过测量大量星系的形状相关性和红移分布，可以重建宇宙物质功率谱 $P(k)$，并对 $\Omega_{\rm m}$、$\sigma_8$ 等结构形成参数给出精确约束。传统分析多依赖两点统计量，而机器学习有望从弱透镜数据中提取非高斯信息；但真实分析受到点扩散函数、测光红移误差、内禀排列、重子反馈以及模拟器不完美等多重系统效应影响，因此需要标准化基准来检验方法在系统不确定性下的稳健性。
contribution: 本文提出并发布 FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Machine Learning Uncertainty Challenge（NeurIPS 2025 竞赛）的基准数据集与评测研究。该数据集面向真实弱引力透镜观测，纳入多种系统偏差，**为在不确定性下开展稳健宇宙学推断提供了受控测试平台**。论文系统总结了挑战赛获胜方案的方法学进展，包括基于 conditional optimal transport 的数据增强、AI agent 驱动的参数推断、集成学习、基于 Vision Transformer 的架构以及物理信息特征融合。**通过统一基准数据集与优胜方案，本工作为弱引力透镜宇宙学及更广泛的系统不确定性下机器学习科学推断提供了社区资源**。
summary: Weak gravitational lensing is a powerful cosmological probe that enables direct mapping of the matter distribution and precise constraints on the fundamental parameters governing structure formation in the universe. In recent years, machine learning has shown strong potential for extracting cosmological information from weak-lensing data beyond traditional summary statistics. However, progress has been limited by the lack of standardized benchmarks that capture the complexity of the dataset, simulator imperfections, and various systematic biases encountered in realistic analyses. To address this gap, we present the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Machine Learning Uncertainty Challenge, one of the NeurIPS 2025 competitions, as a benchmark dataset and evaluation study. Our dataset reflects realistic weak-lensing observations, incorporating multiple systematic biases, and thereby providing a controlled testbed for robust cosmological inference under uncertainties. We summarize the main methodological advances developed by the winners of our challenge, including data augmentation with conditional optimal transport, an AI-agent-driven approach for parameter inference, ensemble learning, Vision Transformer-based architectures, and physics-informed feature integration. By unifying the benchmark dataset and the winning solutions, this work provides a community resource for developing and evaluating machine learning methods for weak lensing cosmology and, more broadly, for scientific inference under systematic uncertainties.

title: Probing circumstellar interaction with spectroscopy of ZTF hydrogen-rich superluminous supernovae
background_knowledge: 富氢超亮超新星（H-rich superluminous supernovae, H-rich SLSNe）是一类峰值光度远高于普通超新星、且光谱中具有显著氢 Balmer 线的稀有瞬变天体。其巨大辐射能量可能来自爆发本身、激波与星周介质相互作用、以及贫氢或富氢包层的特殊前身星演化等多种机制。理解这类天体的关键物理图像是：大质量恒星在爆炸前可能经历增强的质量损失，在周围形成致密星周介质（circumstellar material, CSM）；超新星辐射与激波的传播会电离并加热 CSM，从而产生窄 Balmer 发射线、可能的闪电离（flash-ionisation）特征以及随时间变化的不对称线翼。光谱分类上，具有窄 Balmer 发射的相互作用超新星常被归为 SNe IIn；当类似特征出现在热核爆炸背景下时，则涉及 Ia-CSM 亚类。研究范式通常包括大样本光谱监测、分类与光谱演化统计、$H\alpha$ 等谱线的等值宽和线宽测量，以及借助电子散射等辐射转移模型解释线轮廓。Balmer decrement、pEW 与 FWHM 等观测量还可用于比较不同光度、不同 CSM 性质的对象，并检验爆炸前质量损失历史。
contribution: 本文利用 Zwicky Transient Facility（ZTF）观测的 106 颗富氢 SLSNe 的 304 条光学光谱，系统分析其光谱演化与 Balmer 线性质，并用 Monte Carlo 电子散射计算拟合 $H\alpha$ 轮廓。**106 颗中有 105 颗呈现与 SLSN-IIn 一致的窄 Balmer 发射，包括 6 颗具有额外 Ia-CSM 样特征、3 颗可能存在 flash-ionisation 特征；仅 1 颗只显示宽 Balmer 发射并归类为 SLSN-II。** 峰后 Balmer 轮廓从近对称的指数型，变化到具有明显蓝端超出或肩部的不对称型。**具有 Balmer 线蓝端超出的天体倾向具有更高的拟合光子发射壳层速度，并总体比持续对称轮廓者更暗。** SLSNe-IIn 的 $H\alpha$ 伪等值宽（pEW）和 FWHM 与较低光度 SNe IIn 重叠，但其 pEW 演化比宽线 SLSN-II 对比样本更多样。样本的 Balmer decrement 中位数从 $+100$ d 前的 2.85 增至其后的 4.40，且始终低于 Ia-CSM 对比样本。与较低光度 SNe IIn 的现有比较未发现 SLSNe-IIn 独有的 Balmer 线形态，尽管部分 SLSNe-IIn 显示延展的高电离发射。**结果支持致密 CSM 由爆炸前增强的质量损失形成，并提示明亮富氢相互作用超新星中可能存在隐藏的 Ia-CSM 族群。**
summary: Hydrogen-rich superluminous supernovae (H-rich SLSNe) are rare, exceptionally luminous transients. Most exhibit narrow Balmer emission and can be further classified as SLSNe-IIn, indicating interaction with dense circumstellar material (CSM). We present and analyse 304 optical spectra of 106 H-rich SLSNe observed by the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF). We examine their spectral evolution and Balmer-line properties, and model the H$α$ profiles using Monte Carlo electron-scattering calculations. Of the 106 objects, 105 exhibit narrow Balmer emission consistent with SLSN-IIn classifications, including six with additional Ia-CSM-like characteristics and three with possible flash-ionisation features; the remaining one object exhibits only broad Balmer emission and is classified as a SLSN-II. Post-peak Balmer profiles range from approximately symmetric, exponential profiles to asymmetric profiles with prominent blue excesses or shoulders. Objects with Balmer line blue excess favour higher fitted photon-emitting shell velocities and tend to be fainter than those with persistently symmetric profiles. The H$α$ pseudo-equivalent width (pEW) and FWHM of SLSNe-IIn overlap with those of lower-luminosity SNe IIn, while the pEW evolution is more diverse than in the broad-lined SLSN-II comparison sample. Our SLSNe-IIn sample's median Balmer decrement increases from 2.85 before $+100$ d to 4.40 afterwards, remaining consistently below that of the comparison Ia-CSM sample. We identify no Balmer-line morphology unique to SLSNe-IIn in the available comparison with lower-luminosity SNe IIn, although some SLSNe-IIn exhibit prolonged high-ionisation emission. Our results also support interaction with dense CSM formed through enhanced pre-explosion mass loss. We also highlight a possible hidden Ia-CSM population among luminous H-rich interacting SNe.

title: Classical Cepheids in the 4MOST era I: Methodology for 4MOST variable stars and NLTE abundance gradients in the Milky Way
background_knowledge:
经典造父变星（Classical Cepheids，CCs）是年轻、中等质量恒星演化到不稳定带时的径向脉动体，其光变周期与内禀光度之间的紧密关系使其成为近邻宇宙中最重要的距离指示器之一。周期–光度–金属丰度（PLZ）关系中的金属丰度依赖会引入距离系统误差，并传递到 Hubble 常数 $H_0$ 的标定，因此准确测定其大气参数与化学组成十分关键。在银河系研究中，造父变星作为年轻星族的示踪物，可用于刻画盘的结构、运动学与化学丰度分布。
\n传统高分辨率光谱丰度分析依赖恒星大气模型、辐射转移与谱线形成理论。若采用局部热动平衡（LTE）假设，可能在高温、低密度、弱线及痕量元素中产生偏差；非局部热动平衡（NLTE）效应会改变电离平衡、谱线强度与丰度结果。银河系薄盘与厚盘存在径向化学梯度，不同元素（如 Fe 峰元素、α 元素与中子俘获元素）的梯度形状和斜率反映了恒星形成史与化学演化；外盘可能出现梯度变平。大型光谱巡天（如 4MOST 及其 4MIDABLE-HR）将提供海量造父变星高分辨率光谱，需要快速、均匀、可扩展到 NLTE 的分析方法；基于人工神经网络、用 NLTE 合成光谱训练的 Payne 类方法，为从光谱中快速反演大气参数和元素丰度提供了新范式。
contribution: 论文面向 4MOST 4MIDABLE-HR 预期的大样本经典造父变星，提出了一套在 NLTE 框架下测定造父变星大气参数与化学丰度的方法。作者利用在 NLTE 光谱上训练的 Payne 人工神经网络，对 17 种元素进行反演：O、Na、Mg、Al、Si、Ca、Ti、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Sr、Y、Ba、Eu 采用 NLTE，C 与 Cr 采用 LTE。将该方法应用于归档造父变星光谱后，作者获得了覆盖金属丰度约 $-0.87$ 至 $+0.35$ dex 的稳健 NLTE 恒星参数与丰度，并据此推导银河系径向化学梯度。对于具有多历元光谱的恒星，**NLTE 丰度在脉动周期内保持一致，而 LTE 丰度呈现更大的离散与偏差**。所得丰度分布和梯度与银河系盘化学演化模型的预期相符；作者**确认外盘在 $R_{\rm GC} \sim 15\,\mathrm{kpc}$ 以外梯度变平**，并**首次给出 Co、Ni、Y 和 Eu 的 NLTE 径向梯度**。结果还表明，在 4MOST-HR 的分辨率下，该 NLTE 天体物理分析可给出一致且稳健的参数与丰度解，从而支持未来巡天开展大规模、均匀的造父变星研究，并为收紧银河系化学演化模型约束和距离尺度工作提供基础。
summary: Classical Cepheids (CCs) are key distance indicators and tracers of young stellar populations in the Milky Way. Their period-luminosity-metallicity (PLZ) relation also makes them calibrators of the Hubble constant $H_0$. Despite their importance, chemical composition, especially non-LTE (NLTE) effects, remains a significant source of systematics in PLZ applications. In preparation for the large CCs sample expected from the 4MIDABLE-HR (4MOST Consortium Survey 4: Milky Way Disc and Bulge High-Resolution) survey, we present a method for deriving Cepheid atmospheric parameters and chemical abundances in NLTE. Using the Payne artificial neural network (ANN) trained on NLTE spectra, we derive atmospheric parameters and abundances for 17 elements: O, Na, Mg, Al, Si, Ca, Ti, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Sr, Y, Ba, Eu in NLTE and C and Cr in LTE. We apply the new method to archival spectra of Cepheids and derive radial chemical gradients in the Milky Way. We derive robust NLTE stellar parameters and abundances for Cepheids spanning metallicities from $\sim -0.87$ to $\sim +0.35$ dex. For stars with multi-epoch spectra, we find that NLTE abundances are consistent across the pulsation cycle, whereas LTE values show larger dispersions and biases. The resulting abundance distributions and gradients align well with Galactic disk expectations from chemical evolution models. We confirm that the gradients flatten in the outer disk beyond $R_{\rm GC} \sim 15\,\mathrm{kpc}$ and provide the first NLTE gradients for Co, Ni, Y, and Eu. We show that our NLTE astrophysical analysis yields robust solutions for atmospheric parameters and chemical abundances across spectra at the resolving power of 4MOST-HR. This enables large, homogeneous studies with upcoming surveys such as 4MOST 4MIDABLE-HR and provides a solid basis for tightening constraints on Galactic chemical evolution models and Cepheid distance-scale work.

title: B-fields In STar-forming Region Observations (BISTRO): Population-Level Universality and Environmental Structuring of 450/850 $μ$m Polarization Signatures
background_knowledge: 分子云是恒星形成的场所，其亚毫米波连续谱主要来自冷尘埃的热辐射。非球形尘埃晶粒可在辐射场中定向排列（例如通过辐射力矩），使热辐射具有线偏振；观测到的偏振度 $P$ 与偏振位置角携带磁场几何、尘埃晶粒排列效率及颗粒性质的信息。JCMT/POL-2 等亚毫米波偏振仪通过 450 $\mu$m 与 850 $\mu$m 双波段成像研究分子云磁场。不同波长对应不同的尘埃温度、光学深度和晶粒排列条件，因此比较偏振度、偏振位置角以及总强度谱指数 $\alpha$ 与偏振强度谱指数 $\gamma$，可检验偏振发射的波长依赖和晶粒排列模型。样本比较还需考虑角分辨率：固定波束在天球上对应的物理尺度随距离变化，环境类别与物理尺度可能耦合。BISTRO 项目以大样本分子云偏振观测研究磁场在恒星形成中的作用及其环境依赖性。
contribution: 论文利用 JCMT 上 POL-2 偏振仪在 450 $\mu$m 与 850 $\mu$m 观测了 69 个分子云区域，并将图像匹配到共同的 12.6 角秒波束。**450 $\mu$m 的偏振度整体低于 850 $\mu$m，30 个可测比值的中位数为 $P_{450}/P_{850}=0.69 \pm 0.02_{\rm sys} \pm 0.03_{\rm stat}$**。在 35 个具有可靠总强度谱指数 $\alpha$ 与偏振强度谱指数 $\gamma$ 的区域中，按源统计的中位数为 $\langle\alpha\rangle=3.33$、$\langle\gamma\rangle=2.85$--$3.04$；**$\gamma-\alpha$ 的中位数为 $-0.57$ 至 $-0.45$，且在 24--27 个区域中 $\gamma<\alpha$**，这些范围涵盖了对低于噪声的偏振强度采用两种极端 $3\sigma$ 上限处理所得的结果。13 个区域中位位置角有 10 个在 $10^\circ$ 内一致，**不支持会使角度旋转的几何起源**。9 个低质量、19 个高质量和 7 个中央分子区（CMZ）区域的 $\gamma-\alpha$ 中位数并不呈低质量 $<$ 高质量 $<$ CMZ 的排序（Jonckheere-Terpstra $p=0.43$--$0.70$），**类别间差异未被稳健检测到**；Kruskal-Wallis 检验 $p=0.056$--$0.078$，单独排除 Rosette 分子云后变为 $p=0.026$--$0.041$，不过高质量类别在每种处理下中位数都最低。各类别还遵循距离序列（波束对应 0.008--0.51 pc），使环境与物理尺度相互耦合。云内分析显示，在 7 个具有足够动态范围的场中，**450 $\mu$m 偏振度均随 Herschel 柱密度增加而下降**。合并像素得到的系数混合了云内趋势、云间差异与 OMC 1 的影响，因而不能定义适用于单个像素的单一规律。跨源波长依赖为尘埃晶粒排列提供了基准，但尚不能按环境排序，作者也不提出唯一机制。
summary: We observed 69 molecular cloud regions at 450 and 850 $μ$m with the POL-2 polarimeter on the James Clerk Maxwell Telescope and matched the maps to a common $12.6''$ beam. Polarization fractions are typically lower at 450 $μ$m. The median of 30 measured ratios is $P_{450}/P_{850} = 0.69 \pm 0.02_{\rm sys} \pm 0.03_{\rm stat}$. Across 35 regions with reliable spectral indices of total ($α$) and polarized ($γ$) intensity, the medians over sources are $\langleα\rangle = 3.33$ and $\langleγ\rangle = 2.85$-$3.04$. The median $γ- α$ is $-0.57$ to $-0.45$, with $γ< α$ in 24-27 regions. These ranges span the two extreme placements of $3σ$ limits for polarized intensity below the noise floor. The position angles at the two wavelengths agree within $10^\circ$ in 10 of 13 regional medians, disfavoring a geometric origin that would rotate the angles. The medians of $γ-α$ in 9 low-mass, 19 high-mass and 7 Central Molecular Zone (CMZ) regions are not ordered low-mass $<$ high-mass $<$ CMZ (Jonckheere-Terpstra $p = 0.43$-$0.70$). A difference among classes is not robustly detected. The Kruskal-Wallis $p = 0.056$-$0.078$ becomes $p = 0.026$-$0.041$ when the Rosette Molecular Cloud alone is excluded, although the high-mass class has the lowest median in every treatment. The classes follow a distance sequence (the beam spans 0.008-0.51 pc), coupling environment and physical scale. Within clouds, the 450 $μ$m polarization fraction decreases with Herschel column density in all 7 fields with sufficient dynamic range. Coefficients from pooled pixels mix trends within clouds, differences between clouds, and the influence of OMC 1. They therefore do not define a single law for individual pixels. The wavelength dependence across sources provides a benchmark for grain alignment. We cannot order it by environment and do not propose a unique mechanism.

title: Evidence for Ambipolar Diffusion from Ion-Neutral Velocity Drift in HH 212
background_knowledge: 低质量恒星形成通常始于分子云核的引力坍缩，形成 Class 0 原恒星、吸积盘、外流以及仍大量吸积的致密包层。磁场在其中可通过对带电粒子的约束和磁制动影响角动量输运、盘形成与包层坍缩；在理想 MHD 图像下，离子与中性粒子通过碰撞紧密耦合，磁通量随流体冻结。真实原恒星包层电离度很低，因而会出现非理想 MHD 效应，其中双极扩散描述离子受磁力作用而相对中性粒子漂移、导致离子与中性粒子部分解耦的过程，此外还包括欧姆耗散与霍尔效应。观测上，高分辨率分子谱线可分别追踪中性示踪物与离子示踪物，利用超精细结构、谱线宽度与中心速度约束包层运动、电离度和离子-中性速度差；结合辐射转移与非理想 MHD 模型，可检验双极扩散、霍尔参数以及磁能、旋转能与引力能的相对重要性。HH 212 是研究这类问题的典型 Class 0 原恒星系统。
contribution: 论文利用 ALMA Band 7 对 Class 0 原恒星系统 HH 212 的 C$^{17}$O (3-2) 超精细结构和 H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$ (4-3) 分子谱线进行约 44 au 分辨率观测，并在非理想 MHD 框架下通过辐射转移模型分析包层。模型得到包层质量 $ M_{\rm env}\sim0.12\,M_\odot $ 和质量下落率 $ \dot{M}_{\rm env}\sim4.4-5.7\times10^{-6}\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1} $，与文献值一致；更重要的是，模型揭示中性示踪物 C$^{17}$O (3-2) 与离子示踪物 H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$ (4-3) 之间存在 $ 0.1-0.3\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}} $ 的系统性径向速度漂移，超过 $ 0.105\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}} $ 的谱分辨率，**与包层中可能存在的双极扩散一致**。双极扩散分数 $ f_{AD}\sim0.1-1 $、霍尔参数 $ \beta_{i,H_2}\gg1 $，**表明离子与中性粒子部分解耦，非理想效应在内部区域更显著**。能量分析显示，旋转能从 $ R_{\rm cen} $ 处约占引力能的 $ \sim50\% $ 降至 $ 2R_{\rm cen} $ 处的 $ \sim25\% $ 和 1100 au 处的 $ \sim4\% $；对 $ B_0=1\,\mathrm{mG} $，磁能从 $ R_{\rm cen} $ 处约占引力能的 $ \sim0.4\% $ 增至 $ 2R_{\rm cen} $ 处的 $ \sim2.6\% $ 和 1100 au 处的 $ \sim20\% $。由径向力平衡预期的漂移速度在中心源约 300-400 au 内与模型漂移速度一致，但在更大半径处偏低。上述结果**支持双极扩散导致部分离子-中性解耦、使包层中性粒子比离子运动更快的图景**。
summary: We present the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array Band 7 observations of the hyperfine structure of C$^{17}$O (3-2) and the H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$ (4-3) molecular line emissions of the Class 0 protostellar system HH 212 at $\sim$ 44 au spatial resolution. Radiative transfer models interpreted in the framework of non-ideal MHD of the envelope allow us to estimate an envelope mass of $M_{env}\sim0.12\,M_\odot$ and a mass infall rate of $\dot{M}_{env}\sim4.4-5.7\times10^{-6}\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, consistent with values reported in the literature. The models also reveal a systematic radial velocity drift between the neutral tracer (C$^{17}$O (3-2)) and the ionized species (H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$ (4-3)) of $0.1-0.3$ km s$^{-1}$, exceeding the spectral resolution of 0.105 km s$^{-1}$ and consistent with possible ambipolar diffusion in the envelope. The ambipolar diffusion fraction, $f_{AD}\sim 0.1-1$, and the Hall parameter, $β_{i,H_2}\gg1$, indicate partial ion-neutral decoupling, with non-ideal effects becoming more significant toward the inner regions. In the envelope, our analysis shows that rotational energy decreases from $\sim 50\,\%$ of the gravitational energy at $R_{cen}$ to $\sim 25\,\%$ at $2R_{cen}$ and $\sim4\,\%$ at 1100 au. In contrast, for $B_0=1$ mG, magnetic energy increases from $\sim 0.4\,\%$ of the gravitational energy at $R_{cen}$ to $\sim2.6\,\%$ at $2R_{cen}$ and $\sim20\,\%$ at 1100 au. The drift velocity expected from radial force balance is consistent with the modeled drift velocity within $\sim300-400$ au of the central source but is lower at larger radii. These results are consistent with a scenario in which ambipolar diffusion leads to partial ion-neutral decoupling, allowing neutrals to move faster than ions within the envelope.

title: From Exo-Earth Detection to Atmospheric Characterization: Enabling Phase-Dependent Molecular Detection SNR in EXOSIMS
background_knowledge: 系外地球探测与大气表征是未来直接成像空间任务的核心科学目标之一。NASA 的 Habitable Worlds Observatory（HWO）计划首次系统搜寻类太阳恒星周围的类地行星，并通过反射光谱寻找氧气（$O_2$）、水（$H_2O$）等潜在生物标志。直接成像观测到的行星信号随相位角变化：行星越接近月牙相位，反射光通量越低，但光谱中分子特征的相对信息量可能不同；因此，分子探测所需信噪比（$SNR$）并非固定，而取决于相位、波长、仪器噪声与积分时间。EXOSIMS 是常用的任务产率模拟框架，负责把观测策略、仪器性能与行星分布结合，估算探测和表征数量。光谱反演工具可根据模拟光谱判断探测特定分子所需的最小 $SNR$，进而影响表征积分时间与产率。该子领域的核心研究范式是：以接近物理真实的仪器与行星模型进行端到端模拟，评估任务设计对发现宜居世界和生物标志的效能。
contribution: 本文将相位依赖的生物标志可探测性引入 EXOSIMS 框架：利用光谱反演工具 rfast 确定探测大气 $O_2$ 与 $H_2O$ 所需 $SNR$ 随行星相位的变化，并将这些需求直接纳入 EXOSIMS 的表征积分时间计算。研究发现，虽然所需分子探测 $SNR$ 随行星趋向月牙相位而降低，**成功分子探测主要集中在中等的相位角**，体现了分子信息含量与直接成像可观测性之间的竞争。相对于固定阈值（$H_2O$ 为 $SNR = 5$、$O_2$ 为 $SNR = 8.5$），相位依赖处理使**平均分子探测产率提高 76.8%（$H_2O$）和 29.7%（$O_2$）**。该工作提供了更真实的模拟框架，提升 EXOSIMS 的仿真保真度，并为未来把探测与表征统一纳入 HWO 产率建模、扩展其他生物标志研究奠定基础。
summary: Detection and characterization of Earth-like worlds is a primary science goal for the upcoming NASA flagship Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO). The HWO mission will be the first of its kind to specifically search for Earth-like worlds around Sun-like stars and characterize their atmospheres to identify potential biosignatures. A mission with such ambitious science goals thus requires equally robust and physically realistic simulation tools. In this work, we extend the realism of the EXOSIMS framework by incorporating phase-dependent biosignature detectability. We use the spectral retrieval tool rfast to determine the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) required to detect atmospheric O2 and H2O as a function of planetary phase and incorporate these requirements directly into EXOSIMS characterization integration-time calculations. Although the required molecular detection SNR decreases toward increasingly crescent phases, successful molecular detections are concentrated at intermediate phase angles, demonstrating the competing effects of molecular information content and direct-imaging observability. Relative to fixed characterization thresholds of SNR = 5 for H2O and SNR = 8.5 for O2, the phase-dependent treatment increases mean molecular detection yield by 76.8 percent for H2O and 29.7 percent for O2. Ultimately, we provide a framework that improves simulation fidelity, increases the realism of EXOSIMS as we expand to assess additional biosignatures in future work, and marries detection and characterization in yield modeling as we look to the future with HWO.

title: Stellar Disruption and Black Hole Retention in Massive Collisions: The Role of Thermonuclear Feedback
background_knowledge: 该工作属于恒星碰撞、致密天体埋藏与恒星热核燃烧交叉的“黑洞星”（black hole star，BH*）研究。基本图像是：在密集星团或星系核等环境中，恒星级黑洞可能与一颗大质量恒星发生近乎正碰；若黑洞质量远小于恒星质量，它可因气体阻力损失轨道能量并被俘获，最终沉到恒星中心，形成由恒星包层包裹黑洞的类 Thorne-Żytkow 天体。恒星能否存活取决于能量收支：黑洞穿行时的阻力耗散、引力势能释放、周围气体压缩加热以及热核反应释能，都必须与恒星自身的引力束缚能比较；若额外注入能量接近束缚能，包层可被吹散，黑洞便不再被保留。大质量恒星结合能相对质量较小，金属丰度会影响 CNO 燃烧与不透明度，氦富星结构更松散，因此这些因素会改变存活判据。高温下 CNO 循环可进入 β 限定的 hot-CNO 区间，燃烧率对温度不敏感但产能强，可能在一到几个动力学时标内产生显著反馈。
contribution: 作者用 AthenaK 开展正碰流体模拟，把与气体耦合的 CNO 燃烧纳入 $q=0.1$ 与 $0.2$ 的黑洞—恒星碰撞，覆盖 $100$ 与 $500\,M_\odot$ 的恒星质量，以及太阳成分、贫金属和富氦成分。所有 $q\le0.2$ 模型都显示，阻力耗散的能量与俘获黑洞给气体增加的束缚能相当或更小，单靠阻力不足以瓦解恒星；但气体在黑洞周围受压缩被加热到 $\gtrsim2\times10^8\,\mathrm{K}$，并以 β 限定的 hot-CNO 速率发生热核燃烧。黑洞沉入中心后约一个动力学时标内，核反应释能可达到恒星束缚能 $\tfrac32\bar\beta\int P\,dV$ 的显著比例；一旦累计释能达到该束缚能，恒星便失去大部分质量，而低于阈值时释能率下降。**太阳成分恒星与 $q=0.2$ 黑洞合并会在释放大部分总质量后瓦解；结合能与总能量产额几乎相同的贫金属星与同质量黑洞合并后仅少量质量损失并存活。** 与 $q=0.1$ 黑洞合并后，太阳成分和贫金属星都存活为黑洞星，并以 $\gtrsim10^{44}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$ 的速率远离热平衡燃烧。**极高质量和富氦、束缚较弱的恒星最容易被瓦解。**
summary: A stellar-mass black hole (BH) that collides with a massive star can be captured by drag and settle at its center as a black hole star. Hydrodynamic simulations that neglect nuclear reactions have found that the star survives and becomes a black hole star (BH*) for BH-to-star mass ratios $q\lesssim0.2$. We perform hydrodynamic simulations of head-on collisions with the \athenak\ code, including CNO burning coupled to the gas, for $q=0.1$ and $0.2$ BHs, stellar masses of $100$ and $500\,M_{\odot}$, solar, metal-deficient, and Helium-rich compositions. In all models (with $q\le0.2$), the energy dissipated by drag is comparable to or less than the binding energy that the captured BH adds to the gas so that it alone does not disrupt the star. But, under compression around the captured BH, gas is heated to $\gtrsim2\times10^8$\,K and undergoes thermonuclear burning at the $β$-limited hot-CNO rate. Within about one dynamical time after the BH settles at the center, the nuclear energy released during the encounter becomes a significant fraction of the star's binding energy $\tfrac32\barβ\int P\,dV$. The star loses most of its mass once the cumulative release reaches this binding energy. Below this threshold, the release rate declines. Merger between a solar-composition star and a BH with a mass ratio $q=0.2$ leads to the disruption of the star after releasing most of its total mass. But a metal-poor star, with nearly the same binding energy and total yield, survives with minor release after merger with an identical BH. After coalescence with a less massive ($q=0.1$) BH, stars with both solar and metal-poor composition survive as black hole stars, burning at a rate $\gtrsim 10^{44}\,{\rm erg\,s^{-1}}$, far from thermal equilibrium. Very massive and helium-rich stars, which are weakly bound, are the most easily disrupted.

title: The Physics of Interstellar Travel
background_knowledge: 星际旅行是一个由天体物理学、相对论力学与航天工程交叉形成的研究议题，它并不属于传统天文观测分支，而是以已知物理定律为约束，对“人类能否抵达最近的恒星”做量级估计与系统级权衡。问题的起点是尺度：离太阳最近的恒星系统比邻星（Proxima Centauri）距我们约 4.24 光年，而飞得最远的人造物体旅行者 1 号（Voyager 1）速度约 17 km/s，走完这段距离需要数万年；因此“在人的一生内抵达”要求速度达到光速的百分之几乃至更高，远超化学火箭的能力范围。按照齐奥尔科夫斯基火箭方程 $v = v_e \ln(m_0/m_f)$，提升速度要么依赖极高的排气速度（比冲），要么依赖极端的质量比，前者指向核热、核裂变或核聚变推进，后者在工程上很快变得不可行；由此催生了“光束推进”范式（激光帆、微波帆）：加速所需的能量由地面或空间中的定向能装置提供，航天器不携带工质，本体可做得极轻（克级至千克级的光帆），代价是极高的指向精度与光束功率要求。另一方面，星际空间并非真空：星际介质平均密度约为 $1\ \mathrm{cm^{-3}}$，包含原子、离子与尘埃颗粒；在相对论速度下，单个尘埃颗粒的相对动能可达宏观炸药量级，因此“能否在撞击中存活”与屏蔽、规避设计直接决定任务可行性。通信则受制于信号强度随距离平方衰减，以及衍射极限 $\theta \approx \lambda/D$ 对射电或激光链路带宽与指向的约束，是数据回传的核心瓶颈。此外还需解决自主导航（如脉冲星计时、恒星天文测量定位）与长期星载供电。
contribution: 本文是一篇半通俗（semi-popular）综述短文，并不报告新的观测或计算结果，而是系统梳理星际飞行涉及的物理问题、挑战与可能方案。作者围绕几个核心议题展开：（1）**推进方式**——讨论核火箭与激光帆等方案如何应对把无人航天器送入最近恒星系统、并在人的一生内抵达这一目标；（2）**星际介质中的尘埃撞击**——考察航天器高速穿越星际介质时能否存活；（3）**通信**——探讨在极远距离上回传数据的可行途径；（4）抵达目的地后所能开展的科学研究。此外，作者明确指出导航与星载供电同样属于任务成败的关键环节；这些问题与上述议题在其专著《The Physics of Interstellar Travel》（2026）中有更详细的展开，本文的定位是对星际旅行物理的图像化、量级化整体审视。
summary: How can we send an uncrewed spacecraft to the nearest stars within a human lifetime? What propulsion methods are available? Will it survive impacts in the interstellar medium? What science will it do at its destination? How can it send back data over enormous distances? In this short semi-popular article, I examine various aspects of the physics of interstellar travel, its challenges and possible solutions. I focus on nuclear rockets, laser sails, dust impacts, and communication. These, as well as other issues such as navigation and onboard power, are explored in more detail in my book, The Physics of Interstellar Travel (2026).

title: Horizon-penetrating rotating black-hole configurations in VCDM
background_knowledge: 在广义相对论中，黑洞时空由度规与视界结构刻画，Schwarzschild、Kerr、Reissner-Nordström、Kerr-Newman 以及带宇宙学常数的 de Sitter 解构成研究旋转、带电与视界穿透问题的基准。视界并非物理奇点，但常用坐标会在视界处出现坐标奇异，因此需要正则或穿透视界的表述来构造跨视界解。对正则黑洞而言，度规正则并不自动意味着所有引力场都正则；在带优选叶层的修改引力（如题中的 VCDM）里，叶层与辅助场也是引力解的一部分，必须同时满足正则性与通量条件。常平均曲率叶层、内外渐近端以及有限固有距离端点或 trumpet 端等概念，决定了稳态构造能否延拓以及内部区域应如何解释。
contribution: 论文指出：**正则黑洞度规不必给出 VCDM 的正则组态**，因为优选叶层属于引力解本身。作者在辅助场为常数的 Einstein-Maxwell 分支上构造稳态旋转、可能带电的组态：其 Kerr-Newman 与 Kerr-Newman-de Sitter 几何携带非零常平均曲率叶层，并**穿过未来黑洞视界**，在 de Sitter 情形还**穿过未来宇宙学视界**。以视界正则的通量表述确定内部数据，并区分双曲型与膨胀型渐近端；给出 17 个勘察组态，补充固定四维几何下的平均通量扫描，以及低至 $\kappa M = 0.01$、其中 $K_0 = 3\kappa$ 的平直几何与 de Sitter 几何配对比较。改变通量会改变优选叶层的剪切，但**不改变标准测试物质所见的背景四维几何**。配对的局部 lapse 与剪切差在计算范围内有效幂次接近 2，其中 lapse 比较需固定时间归一化；连续残差、几何重构与选定网格比较检验数值解。作者证明当 $\Delta_r > 0$ 时精确的 lapse 界排除正则稳态外部块中的零点，区分奇异的有限固有距离端点与渐近 trumpet 端，并对稳态类空内极限给出条件性界限。局部宇宙学解释仍需额外匹配假设；**动力学选择与旋转内部端点不能由该稳态构造确定**。
summary: A regular black-hole metric need not define a regular configuration of VCDM, whose preferred foliation is part of the gravitational solution. We construct stationary rotating, possibly charged configurations on the constant-auxiliary Einstein-Maxwell branch. Their Kerr-Newman and Kerr-Newman-de Sitter geometries carry nonzero constant-mean-curvature foliations that cross the future black-hole horizon and, in the de Sitter case, the future cosmological horizon. A horizon-regular flux formulation specifies the inner data and the distinct hyperboloidal and expanding asymptotic ends. Seventeen survey configurations are supplemented by a mean-flux scan at fixed four-geometry and paired flat/de Sitter comparisons down to $κM = 0.01$, where $K_0 = 3κ$. Varying the flux changes the preferred-foliation shear without changing the background seen by standard test matter. The paired local lapse and shear differences have effective powers close to two over the computed range, with the lapse comparison requiring a fixed time normalization. Continuous residuals, geometric reconstructions, and selected grid comparisons test the numerical solutions. An exact lapse bound excludes zeros in the regular stationary exterior block with $Δ_r > 0$. We distinguish singular finite-proper-distance endpoints from asymptotic trumpet ends and give conditional bounds on a stationary spacelike inner limit. A local cosmological interpretation requires additional matching assumptions; dynamical selection and the rotating interior endpoint are not determined by the stationary construction.

title: Revisiting the Einstein Cross with X-shooter spectra: New estimates of accretion disk parameters and broad emission line profiles from microlensing
background_knowledge: 类星体由超大质量黑洞吸积供能，其中心吸积盘与宽发射线区在空间上极其致密，通常无法被望远镜直接分辨。强引力透镜可把同一类星体成像为多个宏观像；若透镜星系中的恒星再对某个像产生微引力透镜效应，像的亮度会随源区大小和观测波长而变化。由于吸积盘不同半径处温度不同，短波辐射来自更内层、更紧凑的区域，长波辐射来自较外层、较大的区域，因此微引力透镜的放大率具有波长依赖，即色微引力透镜效应。标准薄盘模型给出温度剖面 $T \propto R^{-3/4}$，并对应特征半径与波长关系 $r_s \propto \lambda^p$，其中标准值 $p=4/3$。宽发射线来自较大的宽线区，可作为比较不同宏观像的参考；透镜星系的尘埃消光则会额外改变能谱形状。利用多波段光谱测量不同像的流量比随波长的变化，并借助模拟微引力透镜放大图和贝叶斯推断，可以反演吸积盘尺度与温度剖面。
contribution: 论文利用 X-shooter 光谱对四重透镜类星体 Q2237+0305（Einstein Cross）开展研究，覆盖 $3000$ 至 $20000$ $\mathring{A}$，是目前该体系最宽的波长覆盖，从而改进了可用的光谱数据。作者以各宏观像的特征发射线为参考，估计像对之间的色微引力透镜效应并计算消光曲线，确认 C 与 A 光谱之间没有由透镜星系消光造成的显著差异。随后，作者采用温度剖面对数斜率为 $1/p$、尺度为 $r_s$ 的薄盘模型，假定 $r_s \propto \lambda^p$，并汇总文献中的三项色微引力透镜测量以检验波长依赖，同时与 $p=4/3$ 的标准薄盘模型比较。通过模拟微引力透镜放大图和多历元观测数据的贝叶斯分析，得到吸积盘尺度 $r_s=4.9^{+2.3}_{-2.6}\,\sqrt{M/0.3M_{\odot}}$（lt-day）和指数 $p=0.77^{+0.47}_{-0.28}$，**进一步支持该吸积盘偏离标准薄盘模型（$T \propto r_s^{-3/4}$）**。
summary: We present a spectroscopic study of the lensed quasar Q2237+0305, the Einstein Cross, assessing the best wavelength coverage to date with the X-shooter instrument (from $3000$ to $20000$ $\mathring{A}$), and thus improving the available spectroscopic data for this system. Using as a reference the characteristic emission lines for each quasar macro-image, we estimate the chromatic microlensing effect between pairs of images and calculate the extinction curve, confirming no significant differences between spectra $C$ and $A$ caused by extinction in the lens galaxy. In addition, we model the accretion disk characterized by a temperature profile with logarithmic slope $1/p$ and size $r_{s}$, assuming a thin-disk model with a power-law function of the form $r_{s}$ $\propto$ $λ^{p}$. To do this, we calculated a set of three chromatic microlensing measurements compiling previous estimates from the literature to test the wavelength dependence. This temperature profile was also compared to the canonical thin-disk model with $p=4/3$. Finally, we estimated the likelihood between the disk model and the observed data collected from multiple epochs through mock microlensing magnification maps and determined the probability density functions of each parameter from a Bayesian analysis. As a result, our estimated values for the accretion disk size and its exponential index are $r_{s}=4.9^{+2.3}_{-2.6}$ $\sqrt{M/0.3M_{\odot}}$ (lt-day) and $p=0.77^{+0.47}_{-0.28}$, respectively, reinforcing a departure from the standard accretion disk model ($ T \propto r_s^{-3/4}$).

title: Ultralight scalar field domain walls and Galileo GNSS atomic clocks
background_knowledge: 超轻标量场是暗物质与基础物理研究中的重要候选之一。若其质量极轻，对应的康普顿波长可达宏观尺度，并可能在早期宇宙相变中形成拓扑缺陷，例如二维片状的 domain wall。此类缺陷穿过局部区域时，会短暂改变标量场背景值；通过与标准模型粒子的微弱耦合，可能引起精细结构常数 $\alpha$、电子质量 $m_e$ 等基本参数的有效变化，进而造成原子跃迁频率的瞬时漂移。原子钟通过比较不同钟的频差来寻找这类信号：共同噪声可在差分测量中部分抵消，而不同原子种类或不同电子结构对基本常数变化的敏感度不同，因此钟网络可用于暗物质缺陷的协同搜索。Galileo 等全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）提供多颗搭载原子钟的卫星、连续时间标记和全球覆盖，适合开展瞬态、相关性信号的统计搜索；但卫星轨道运动、钟噪声、系统误差与非高斯背景要求发展虚警率控制、探测效率评估和 coincidence analysis 等稳健统计方法。
contribution: 论文研究一个 Earth-sized 的超轻标量场 domain wall（DW）穿过欧洲 Galileo 全球导航卫星系统星座时产生的影响，以及对其进行探测的可行性。作者发展并实现了一套统计流程，用于刻画由 $N$ 颗 Galileo 卫星钟组成的子网络的背景噪声统计性质，包括虚警率估计与探测效率分析。基于这些方法，论文开展 coincidence analysis，并建立初步统计框架，以便在钟数据中稳健、受控地搜索 domain-wall crossing，并进一步约束相关基础粒子物理参数。该工作面向 Galileo for Science（G4S 2.0）项目的科学目标；其核心贡献在于**建立面向 Galileo 卫星钟网络的 DW 搜索与统计控制方法学**，并为**从钟数据中导出基础物理参数限制提供初步框架**。
summary: In this article, we study the impact of an Earth-sized ultralight scalar field domain wall (DW) on the European Galileo Global Navigation Satellite System constellation and the feasibility of a related detection. In particular, a set of statistical procedures is developed and implemented to characterize the statistical properties of the background noise for a subnetwork of $N$ Galileo satellite clocks, including a false-alarm rate estimation and a detection efficiency analysis. These methods allow to implement a coincidence analysis and establish a preliminary statistical framework for a robust and controlled search for domain-wall crossings in clock data, and for deriving constraints on the associated fundamental particle physics parameters. The activity is addressed from the point of view of the scientific objectives of the Galileo for Science (G4S$\_2.0$) project.

title: A Self-Interacting Dark-Matter Route to Supermassive Kerr Black Holes via Super-Eddington Bondi Accretion: Mass-Spin Evolution
background_knowledge: 超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的形成与演化是星系天体物理的核心问题之一。标准图像认为，恒星级黑洞种子通过气体吸积和并合逐渐增长；当吸积光度接近 Eddington 极限时，辐射压会限制增长速率，因此在宇宙早期（$z>6$）形成十亿倍太阳质量级黑洞面临时间尺度困难。Bondi 吸积描述致密天体从周围介质中捕获气体的球对称或准球对称流程；在相对论框架下，临界跨声速解决定吸积率，而黑洞自旋通过时空度规、ISCO 与边际束缚轨道改变捕获截面和能量提取。暗物质晕可作为额外燃料库；若暗物质具有排斥性自相互作用（SIDM），其有效压强和相互作用截面会改变晕内气体—暗物质耦合、声速结构与吸积临界性。Kerr 黑洞的旋转流入还携带角动量，使质量增长与自旋演化耦合，因此研究早期黑洞增长需同时追踪质量与自旋。
contribution: 本文把作者此前的 Schwarzschild 临界相对论 Bondi 吸积研究推广到 Kerr 黑洞，并允许流入携带旋转。考虑排斥性自相互作用暗物质，作者在稳态赤道准球对称框架下求解临界跨声速吸积解，发现 **在由 Kerr 边际束缚捕获值所设定的有限流入角动量范围内，光滑临界解仍然存在**。旋转会改变声速结构和吸积效率，但临界密度抵消以及暗物质扇区与暗晕匹配仍保持 Schwarzschild 形式。由此得到的 **超 Eddington 快速质量增长可持续到有限的暗晕燃料供应成为限制因素为止**。由于流入同时携带角动量，恒星级种子能够 **在增长质量的同时被加速自旋**；示例性族群演化表明，该机制提供了一条 **质量—自旋联合增长、通向早期超大质量 Kerr 黑洞的通道**。
summary: Recent JWST observations motivate mechanisms for rapid black-hole growth in the early Universe. Extending our previous Schwarzschild study, we show that critical relativistic Bondi accretion of repulsively self-interacting dark matter remains an efficient super-Eddington channel for Kerr black holes with rotating inflow. Within a stationary equatorial quasi-spherical framework, smooth critical solutions exist over a finite range of inflow angular momentum set by the Kerr marginally bound capture values. Rotation changes the sonic structure and accretion efficiency, while the critical density cancellation and dark-sector/halo matching retain their Schwarzschild form. The resulting rapid growth persists until the finite halo supply becomes limiting. Because the inflow also carries angular momentum, stellar-mass seeds can grow and spin up simultaneously; illustrative population evolutions therefore provide a joint mass--spin route to early supermassive Kerr black holes.

title: Measurement of the Neutrino Spectrum along the Galactic Plane with IceCube
background_knowledge: 高能中微子天文学通过探测 TeV 至 PeV 能量的中微子来研究宇宙线的加速与相互作用。宇宙线与星际气体或辐射场发生强子过程时会产生 π 介子，其衰变产生伽马射线和中微子；中微子几乎不偏转，能直接指向源或沿银道面的弥散发射区域，因此是识别银河系宇宙线加速器和检验强子起源的重要探针。IceCube 中微子天文台利用南极冰层中的大型光学阵列探测中微子与冰相互作用产生的带电粒子切伦科夫光，其中粒子簇射通道对能量重建较有利。沿银道面的弥散高能中微子预期与银河系宇宙线分布、星际气体密度和辐射场有关；测量其通量空间变化和能谱（通常写成 $\Phi \propto E^{-\gamma}$）可与 TeV 伽马射线观测进行多信使比较，从而区分强子与轻子过程。
contribution: 论文利用 IceCube 中微子天文台 10 年的中微子诱导粒子簇射数据，**首次测量了沿银道面的高能中微子通量变化**。作者不依赖模型预期，在银道面多个区域分别拟合中微子通量归一化和谱指数。结果表明，在 $E_{\nu}=5\,\mathrm{TeV}$ 时，内银河区（$|l|<30^{\circ}$、$|b|<8^{\circ}$）单位立体角的中微子通量约为外银河面（$|l|>60^{\circ}$、$|b|<8^{\circ}$）的 **5 倍**；内、外区域的谱指数分别为 $\gamma=2.76^{+0.18}_{-0.15}$ 和 $\gamma=3.13^{+0.57}_{-0.37}$。论文还将 LHAASO 在 $15^{\circ}<l<125^{\circ}$ 测量的 TeV 伽马射线与同一银河系发射区域的中微子进行比较，并在强子伽马射线产生假设下得出两者在不确定度内相容的结论。
summary: We present the first measurement of the variation of the high-energy neutrino flux along the Galactic plane using 10 years of neutrino-induced particle-shower data from the IceCube Neutrino Observatory. In this Letter, we fit both the neutrino flux normalization and the spectral index, in multiple regions along the plane, independent of model expectations. The neutrino flux per solid angle in the inner Galactic region ($\vert l\vert< 30^{\circ}, \vert b\vert < 8^{\circ}$) is approximately five times higher than in the outer Galactic plane ($\vert l\vert>60^{\circ}, \vert b\vert < 8^{\circ}$) at $E_ν=5\mathrm{TeV}$. The spectral indices in the inner and outer region are $γ=2.76^{+0.18}_{-0.15}$ and $γ= 3.13^{+0.57}_{-0.37}$, respectively. Additionally, we compare the same region of Galactic emission measured in $\mathrm{TeV}$ gamma rays by LHAASO ($15^{\circ}<l<125^{\circ}$) to neutrinos, and conclude that the measurements are compatible within uncertainties, under the assumption of hadronic gamma-ray production.

title: The Tierras Observatory: Ultra-Precise Photometry for Characterizing Exoplanets and Their Host Stars
background_knowledge: 系外行星凌星测光通过监测恒星亮度随时间的微小变化来探测行星：当行星从恒星前方经过时，恒星亮度会出现深度约为 $(R_p/R_*)^2$ 的周期性下降，其中 $R_p$ 为行星半径、$R_*$ 为恒星半径。M 型矮星半径小、宜居带行星轨道周期短，因而其凌星深度相对较大、发生频率较高，是搜寻和刻画类地行星的重要目标。但 M 型矮星普遍存在黑子、耀斑和自转调制等活动，恒星自身亮度变化可能与凌星信号相当甚至更强，因此高精度、长时标的测光监测至关重要。测光精度常以千分之一（ppt，$10^{-3}$）衡量，sub-ppt 即优于 $10^{-3}$。地基测光受大气闪烁、天气条件、仪器系统误差和宿主星变异性限制，要在夜内及跨月的时间尺度上同时达到亚千分之一精度具有很高挑战性。
contribution: 论文介绍 Tierras Observatory：位于美国亚利桑那州南部 Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory 的一台 1.3 m 全自动望远镜，并描述其设施与仪器设计、测光流程及实际观测性能。Tierras 在两种时间尺度上实现亚千分之一（sub-ppt）测光精度：夜内精度用于探测和刻画近邻中晚期 M 型矮星周围的行星凌星，跨观测季节的夜际精度用于刻画宿主星的长期光变。**论文首次给出了跨越数月时间尺度、精度优于 sub-ppt 的地基光变曲线**。这一精度使多项系外行星相关研究成为可能，包括测量宿主星自转周期、探测长周期凌星，以及在已知 M 型矮星系统中发现更多类地行星。
summary: The Tierras Observatory is a fully robotic 1.3-m telescope at the Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory in southern Arizona. Tierras achieves sub-part-per-thousand (ppt) photometric precision on two timescales: intra-night, to detect and characterize transits of planets around nearby mid-to-late M dwarfs, and night-to-night across an observing season, to characterize the long-term variability of their host stars. We describe the facility and instrument design, our photometric pipeline, and our on-sky performance. We present the first ground-based light curves with sub-ppt precision over timescales of months. This precision enables a range of exoplanet-related science, including the measurement of host star rotation periods, the detection of long-period transits, and the discovery of additional terrestrial planets in known M dwarf systems.

title: Coupled dark energy and apparent phantom crossing: a potential-independent lower bound
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学中，宇宙晚期加速膨胀通常归因于暗能量，其状态方程 $w = p/\rho$ 描述压强与能量密度之比；宇宙学常数对应 $w = -1$。观测上把 $w < -1$ 称为 phantom 区，把 $w > -1$ 称为 quintessence 区。正则单标量场（canonical scalar field）的 $w$ 不能跨越 $w = -1$ 这条 phantom divide，但若暗能量标量与暗物质耦合，暗物质粒子质量随标量场变化并发生能量交换，则拟合出的暗能量有效状态方程可以表观跨越 $w = -1$。这类模型常用耦合强度 $\beta = d\ln m/d\varphi$ 描述，其中 $m$ 为暗物质质量、$\varphi$ 为标量场。研究范式是利用 BAO、CMB 与 Ia 型超新星等数据重建膨胀史 $H(z)$ 和 $w(z)$，再结合结构增长、透镜与暗物质相互作用检验耦合暗能量；关键问题是观测到的表观 phantom crossing 对耦合强度和暗物质质量演化提出了多强的限制。
contribution: 论文提出一个不依赖于标量场势能形式的耦合暗能量下限。其核心论证是：表观 phantom crossing 要求暗物质在复合之后失去一定比例的质量，而该最小质量损失由膨胀史 $H(z)$ 固定；对常数耦合 $\beta = d\ln m/d\varphi$，暗物质质量只能随标量场运动而改变，场的速度又由 $H(z)$ 决定，因此耦合必须大于一个最小值 $\beta_{\rm min}[H(z)]$。**该界对任意势能均成立**，当场依赖标量场时适用于耦合的最大值，并精确在场于观测范围内静止时达到。对 DESI DR2 最佳拟合，**暗物质须在 $z \simeq 0.8$ 前失去约 5%–7% 的质量，对应 $\beta_{\rm min}=0.047$–$0.058$**；计入数据不确定性后，公开 DESI DR2 链给出 95% 置信度下限落在 $|\beta| > 0.025$ 至 $0.038$ 的范围。将界应用于已发表的耦合 quintessence 拟合时，所有结果均满足该下限，而常数耦合模型只能重现较浅的表观跨越。由于耦合不能小于 $\beta_{\rm min}$，两个已知效应具有最小尺度：暗物质粒子之间的额外吸引至少为引力的百分之零点几，且透镜信号至少比暗物质成团所暗示的弱几个百分点。
summary: Baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), combined with the cosmic microwave background (CMB) and type Ia supernovae, prefer a dark energy whose equation of state was below $-1$ in the past and is above $-1$ today. A canonical scalar field cannot cross this line, but it can appear to do so if it is coupled to dark matter, and we ask how strong this coupling must be, for any potential. We show that the apparent crossing requires the dark matter to lose a minimum fraction of its mass after recombination, fixed by the expansion history $H(z)$. For a constant coupling $β=d\ln m/dφ$, the mass can change only as fast as the field moves, and the speed of the field is itself set by $H(z)$, so that the coupling must be larger than a minimum value $β_{\rm min}[H(z)]$. This bound holds for any potential, applies to the largest value of the coupling when the coupling depends on the field, and is reached exactly when the field comes to rest within the observed range. For the DESI DR2 best fits, the dark matter must lose about 5-7% of its mass by $z\simeq 0.8$, which requires $β_{\rm min}=0.047$-$0.058$; including the uncertainties of the data, the public DESI DR2 chains give the 95% lower limit $|β|>0.025$-$0.038$. We also apply the bound to published fits of coupled quintessence: all of them respect it, and those with a constant coupling reproduce only a shallow version of the crossing. Since the coupling cannot be smaller than $β_{\rm min}$, two known effects of the coupling have a minimum size: an extra attraction between dark matter particles of at least a few tenths of a per cent of gravity, and a lensing signal at least a few per cent weaker than the clustering of dark matter would suggest.

title: Collider-observable curvaton
background_knowledge:
早期宇宙与基础物理研究暴胀、再加热、原初扰动起源以及新粒子与标准模型的相互作用。标准的热大爆炸图像中，暴胀子场的量子涨落在暴胀期间被拉伸到超视界尺度，并在暴胀结束后转化为近标度不变的绝热曲率扰动；再加热过程把暴胀能量转化为标准模型粒子，并决定后续的热历史。
\n曲率子机制是一种替代性的扰动生成图像：一个轻的旁观标量场在暴胀期间获得涨落，暴胀结束后其能量密度可一度增长并占据重要份额，随后衰变，把自身的等曲率扰动转化为最终的绝热曲率扰动。该机制将扰动产生与再加热、衰变过程解耦，因而在模型构建上具有较大自由度，但也要求曲率子的势能在整个宇宙演化中足够平坦、量子与热修正受控，并且其衰变不破坏大爆炸核合成等成功预言。
\n若曲率子通过希格斯门户与希格斯混合，其小质量标量分量可在对撞机、束流 dump 等实验中通过混合或稀有衰变被搜寻。此类研究连接了早期宇宙扰动理论、粒子物理自然性与实验室检验，是早期宇宙与基础物理交叉的重要范式。
contribution: 本文研究曲率子机制的一个技术上自然的实现：曲率子通过与希格斯的**超可重整相互作用**介导衰变。作者计算了曲率子势的量子修正与热修正，并表明这些修正在其整个宇宙演化过程中保持可控。对于高暴胀能标，曲率子通过标准模型等离子体中的**离壳过程**耗散。该模型的**可行参数空间宽广**；在曲率子质量与有量纲希格斯门户耦合最接近同一能标的区域，模型落在拟议的轻希格斯混合标量搜寻的**实验发现范围**内，因而具有对撞机可观测性。
summary: We study a technically natural realization of the curvaton mechanism, in which decay is mediated through the superrenormalizable interaction with the Higgs. We compute the quantum and thermal corrections to the curvaton potential and show that they remain under control throughout its cosmological evolution. For high inflationary scales, the curvaton dissipates through off-shell processes in the Standard Model plasma. The viable parameter space is broad, and the region in which the curvaton mass and dimensionful Higgs-portal coupling are closest in scale lies within the discovery reach of proposed searches for light Higgs-mixed scalars.

title: Tidally-induced vertical asymmetries in the LMC bar and disk
background_knowledge: 本领域研究银河系及其近邻星系（本星系群）的结构、动力学和演化，重点关注 LMC（大麦哲伦云）、SMC（小麦哲伦云）与 MW（银河系）组成的相互作用系统。LMC 是富气矮星系，具有盘与棒；SMC 质量较小，但与 LMC 有多次近心点交会。潮汐力矩可倾斜或翘曲 LMC 盘，激发棒的垂直振荡和屈曲不稳定性（buckling instability），在恒星密度与速度场中留下南北不对称。观测上，Gaia 天体测量可给出恒星的三维位置和自行，傅里叶分解可将结构分解为 $m=1$（翘曲或不对称）、$m=2$（棒或屈曲）等模式；N-body 模拟则用于连接潮汐轨道参数与可观测特征，并检验天体测量误差的影响。
contribution: 论文利用 KRATOS 套件中 7 组代表性的 LMC–SMC–MW N-body 模拟，系统分析 SMC 近心点掠过对 LMC 棒和盘的垂直位置及运动学不对称的影响，并考察不同撞击参数或初始条件的作用。作者采用基于持续同调（persistent homology）的方法区分棒粒子，从而分别研究棒与盘，并用傅里叶分解量化垂直不对称。为检验 Gaia DR3 中观测到的垂直不对称是否由天体测量误差造成，还构建了 Gaia DR3 模拟星表。结果显示：在所有包含相互作用的模拟中，SMC 近心点掠过后 LMC 类星系的棒和盘均出现强烈的 $m=1$ 垂直不对称，表明**棒和盘发生翘曲**；部分模拟的棒还出现 $m=2$ 垂直不对称，表明**棒发生屈曲（buckling）**。作者据此认为，SMC 的多次掠过会在 LMC 的棒和盘中产生与 Gaia DR3 测量相容的垂直不对称，**潮汐相互作用可自然形成翘曲且屈曲的 LMC 棒以及翘曲的 LMC 盘**。与 Gaia DR3 的比较进一步暗示，**SMC 与 LMC 质量比更高的模型可能更有利于重现观测到的 LMC 棒倾斜**，且**最近一次 SMC 近心点掠过发生在距今不超过约 210 至 300 Myr**。
summary: Past observations and simulations have shown that the bar in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) may be tilted with respect to the disk plane, and that the outer LMC disk could be warped. These studies propose that the tilted bar and the warp in the LMC are induced by the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC) pericentric passages. We analyze and quantify the effect of the SMC passage on the vertical position and kinematic asymmetries of both the bar and disk, as a function of different impact parameters or initial conditions. We used seven representative simulations from the KRATOS suite of $N$-body simulations of the LMC, SMC and Milky Way (MW) system for this analysis. To classify bar particles and analyze the bar and disk separately, we adopted a classification method based on persistent homology. To quantify the vertical asymmetries in the bar and disk of the LMC-like galaxy, we applied Fourier decomposition. We constructed Gaia DR3 mock catalogs to study whether the observed vertical asymmetries in Gaia DR3 are caused by astrometric uncertainties. We detect strong $m = 1$ vertical asymmetries in the bar and disk of the LMC-like galaxy for all interacting simulations after the pericentric passage of the SMC-like galaxy, indicative of a warped bar and disk. We also detect $m=2$ vertical asymmetries in the bar of the LMC-like galaxy for some simulations, indicative of a buckling bar. We conclude that the SMC passages induce vertical asymmetries in both the bar and the disk of the LMC, compatible to those measured in Gaia DR3. Tidal interactions naturally give rise to a warped and buckling LMC bar, and a warped LMC disk. Comparison between our results and Gaia DR3 suggest that models with a higher mass ratio between the SMC and the LMC may be favorable for reproducing the observed tilt of the LMC bar, and that the most recent SMC pericentric passage occurred at most 210 to 300 Myr ago.

title: Foreshortening of Polarizer Angles in Wide Field Polarizing Imagers
background_knowledge: 该工作属于天文偏振测量、宽视场成像仪器与定标领域，服务于太阳日冕和日球层观测。偏振描述横电磁波振动方向的各向异性，通常用 Stokes 参数 $I,Q,U,V$ 表示；线偏振度可写为 $p=\sqrt{Q^2+U^2}/I$，偏振角可写为 $\chi=\frac{1}{2}\arctan(U/Q)$。许多科学目标，例如日冕 K-corona 的 Thomson 散射、尘埃散射和磁场结构，只能通过线偏振信号提取。宽视场偏振成像仪器通常让同一目标经过多个不同角度的线偏振片或调制单元，再组合得到 $Q,U$，从而反演偏振亮度和偏振角。理想情况下，各像素对应同一仪器坐标系下的偏振片角度；但在广角镜头下，像素视线相对光轴有大角度，偏振片的有效投影角度会随视场位置改变，即 foreshortening（投影缩短），并叠加光学畸变、透过率变化与几何标定误差。该领域的研究范式是建立几何与仪器模型、开展误差预算，并通过模拟或定标修正角度偏差，以保证弱偏振信号测量所需的系统精度。
contribution: 论文针对 PUNCH 任务中的 WFI 宽视场偏振成像，指出其单视场直径 40 度，足以使线偏振片相对每个像素视线的有效角度发生投影缩短，偏离仪器坐标系中标称的 $-60^\circ$、$0^\circ$ 和 $+60^\circ$。作者用简单几何方法估计：在 WFI 视场内，感知到的偏振片角对 $\pm60^\circ$ 配置约有 $\pm2.5^\circ$ 的变化，对 $0^\circ$ 配置约有 $\pm3.5^\circ$ 的变化。论文进一步给出该角度偏差对 WFI 记录的偏振亮度的影响，并分析光学畸变如何移动投影缩短后的角度位置；最后讨论该效应对未来基于宽视场偏振测量的技术方案的启示。核心结论是 **宽视场投影会使偏振片有效角度在像面上系统性变化，需在仪器建模与偏振定标中加以修正**。
summary: The Polarimeter to Unify Corona and Heliosphere (PUNCH) is a very wide field polarizing imager covering a 90 degree diameter region of the sky, stitched together from four individual fields of view (FOVs), three of which are supported by Wide Field Imagers (WFIs) with 40 degree diameter individual FOVs. The science objective requires precise measurement of linear polarization. The WFI FOV is sufficiently wide that polarizer angles are foreshortened by projection effects relative to the line of sight of each pixel in the instrument, deviating from their nominal angular positions of -60, 0, and +60 degree relative to the instrument frame of reference. These angles are foreshortened by the very wide WFI field of view, changing their effective angle across the image plane - an effect that is analogous to similar challenges of polarimetric right/left channel separation in large-format 3D cinema, such as the IMAX format. Using a simple geometrical approach we estimated the perceived polarizer angle in the WFI FOV will vary by +/-2.5 degree for +/-60 degree and +/-3.5 degree for 0 degree polarizer angles. We present the effect of this deviation on the polarized brightness to be recorded by WFI, along with how optical distortion will shift the location of foreshortened angles. We also discuss the implications of this effect on upcoming technologies based on polarimetry across in wide fields.

title: Studying the Fullerene Nest: JWST Observations of the Planetary Nebula Tc 1. III. Tracing Fullerene-Linked Dust Variation
background_knowledge: 行星状星云是低至中等质量恒星演化晚期抛出的气体和尘埃包层，经中心星紫外辐射电离后成为发射线天体。其星周尘埃记录了恒星核合成产物、尘埃形成与演化，以及物质向星际介质注入的过程。富勒烯是笼状碳分子（如 C$_{60}$、C$_{70}$），可在特定物理化学条件下于星周环境形成，并具有中红外谱带。中红外光谱是诊断星周尘埃矿物组成、粒径分布和加热机制的关键手段：大颗粒可在平衡温度下发射连续谱或较宽的固体特征，而小颗粒或大分子会因单光子随机加热产生谱形较稳定的宽平台。JWST 的 MIRI/MRS 提供空间分辨的中红外积分视场光谱，能逐点测量谱特征变化，从而区分尘埃与富勒烯的空间分布并追踪尘埃处理。Tc 1 是已知富勒烯丰富的行星状星云，为研究富勒烯与尘埃的共存、空间分化和演化联系提供了理想实验室。
contribution: 作者使用 JWST 的 MIRI/MRS 对富勒烯丰富的行星状星云 Tc 1 进行空间分辨的中红外光谱观测，发现**尘埃发射与富勒烯发射并不共空间**。谱中可区分三个宽特征：6–9 μm 平台、9–13 μm 平台和 30 μm 特征。6–9 μm 平台在整个视场内谱形不变，表明其由随机加热的物质产生。9–13 μm 平台的谱形随位置变化，至少可分解为峰值约 9.5 μm、11 μm 和 12 μm 的三个成分；SiC 最可能至少产生 11 μm 成分，且有证据表明 12 μm 成分也可能由 SiC 颗粒产生。各成分相对强度在视场内的变化**暗示 Tc 1 中正在发生尘埃处理**。9.5 μm 成分与 SiC 成分强相关，因而**很可能由类似物质产生**。总体而言，该工作揭示了富勒烯与尘埃在空间分布和谱特征上的分离，并为理解 Tc 1 中尘埃矿物组成及演化处理提供了新观测线索。
summary: We have observed the fullerene-rich planetary nebula Tc 1 with the MIRI/MRS on JWST. The mid-infrared spectra of this spatially resolved source reveal that the dust emission is not co-spatial with the fullerene emission. Three broad features can be distinguished: a 6$\unicode{x2013}$9 $μ$m plateau, a 9$\unicode{x2013}$13 $μ$m plateau and the 30 $μ$m feature. The 6$\unicode{x2013}$9 $μ$m plateau does not change shape spectrally across the entire field of view, indicating it is produced by stochastically heated material. Spectral variations of the 9$\unicode{x2013}$13 $μ$m plateau reveal at least three distinct components, peaking at 9.5 $μ$m, 11 $μ$m and 12 $μ$m respectively. SiC produces most likely at least the 11 $μ$m component and we find evidence that the 12 $μ$m component might be produced by SiC grains too. The variation in relative strength of these components across the field of view hints at dust processing taking place in Tc 1. The 9.5 $μ$m component of the 9$\unicode{x2013}$13 $μ$m plateau has a strong correlation with the SiC component(s) and is thus likely produced by similar material.

title: Satellite Streaks in HETDEX: Spectra, Orbital Identification, and Survey Impact
background_knowledge: 该工作属于地面天文观测中的人造卫星与空间碎片污染、巡天质量控制及空间态势感知交叉方向。随着巨型星座、失效卫星和火箭残骸增多，明亮的人造物体会在长时间曝光图像中留下条纹，或在线状光谱中留下太阳反射连续谱，从而干扰天体测量、测光与光谱识别。近地轨道（LEO）目标角速度大，穿越视场时间短；地球同步轨道（GEO）或高椭圆轨道目标角速度小，可在视场内停留更久，因此同一曝光时间内两者的曝光平均亮度与瞬时亮度关系不同。利用公开的两行轨道根数（TLE）可将条纹与编目目标匹配，并结合观测时刻、望远镜指向和曝光时长估计轨道类型与星等。HETDEX 使用霍比-埃伯利望远镜（Hobby-Eberly Telescope, HET）的大口径与积分场光谱，具有探测暗弱目标的能力，因而其数据也可用于统计暗弱卫星与空间碎片。
contribution: 论文基于 HETDEX 公共数据发布 1（PDR1）中 2017 年 1 月至 2024 年 7 月的 6778 次观测、约 90 deg$^2$ 天区，建立了卫星条纹的光谱数据库并开展统计分析。共在 492 次观测中探测到 527 条条纹，观测层面的污染比例为 7.3%，到 2023—2024 年部分月份升至 20% 以上，但条纹仅遮蔽约 0.09% 的巡天天区。利用存档两行轨道根数，475 条（90.1%）条纹被证认到编目目标：258 条（54%）位于低地球轨道或地球轨道，217 条（46%）为地球同步轨道或高椭圆轨道；仅 35% 的目标于 2010 年以来发射，其余多为废弃火箭体、碎片和较老航天器，反映了 HETDEX 对暗弱目标的灵敏度及 2017—2024 年的观测基线。HET 的 10 m 口径与 HETDEX 约 6 分钟曝光使 LEO 与 GEO 目标的观测星等相近（LEO 中位 $g_{\rm AB}=16.2\pm1.1$，GEO 为 $16.7\pm1.1$）；但校正穿越时间后，瞬时星等差异显著：LEO 为 $g_{\rm inst}=7.4$，GEO 为 $g_{\rm inst}=13.0$，相差 5.6 mag，而曝光平均星等仅差 0.5 mag。将 34 条 Starlink 条纹归一化到 550 km 后得到 $g(550\,{\rm km})=5.95$，与 VisorSat 设计航天器报告的 $V(550\,{\rm km})=5.92\pm0.04$ 均值一致。光谱与太阳反射光一致，仅因信噪比不同而呈现轻微斜率差异。**核心结论是：HETDEX 的条纹污染在观测频次上显著上升，但实际遮蔽天区很小；多数条纹来自旧航天器与碎片而非新发射星座，且曝光时间与轨道类型共同决定了条纹的观测亮度。** 目录、光谱与代码存档于 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22962479。
summary: We present a spectroscopic database and analysis of satellite streaks in Public Data Release 1 (PDR1) from the Hobby-Eberly Telescope Dark Energy Experiment (HETDEX), covering 6778 observations and $\sim$90 deg$^2$ of sky from January 2017 to July 2024. We detect 527 streaks across 492 observations, a contamination fraction of 7.3% that rises to monthly values above 20% by 2023--2024, although the streaks mask only 0.09% of the survey area. Of the 527 streaks, 475 (90.1%) are identified with a cataloged object using archival two-line elements: 258 (54%) lie in low or Earth orbit and 217 (46%) are geostationary or highly elliptical. Only 35% were launched since 2010; the rest are spent rocket bodies, debris, and older spacecraft. This reflects HETDEX's sensitivity to faint objects and its 2017--2024 observing baseline. The Hobby-Eberly Telescope's large 10\,m aperture and HETDEX's $\sim$6\,minute exposures result in similar observed magnitudes for low Earth orbit (LEO) and geostationary Earth orbit (GEO) objects (median $g_{\rm AB}=16.2\pm1.1$ for LEO, $16.7\pm1.1$ for GEO). However, once transit time is corrected for, instantaneous magnitudes differ widely: $g_{\rm inst}=7.4$ for LEO versus $g_{\rm inst}=13.0$ for GEO objects, a difference of 5.6\,mag, while the exposure-averaged magnitudes differ by only 0.5 mag. Normalized to 550 km, the 34 Starlink streaks give $g(550 {\rm km})=5.95$, consistent with the mean $V(550\,{\rm km})=5.92\pm0.04$ reported for VisorSat-design spacecraft. The spectra are consistent with reflected sunlight, with modest, signal-to-noise-driven differences in slope. The catalog, spectra, and code are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22962479.

title: Local Pitch Angles of Galactic Structures in Nearby Galaxies with JWST: I. Spiral Arms and Interarm Substructures in Disk-Dominated Systems
background_knowledge: 盘星系中的旋臂是密度波、非轴对称引力扰动与差异旋转共同作用下形成的准稳态结构。其缠绕程度常用 pitch angle $\alpha$ 描述：在等距对数螺旋近似下，$\tan\alpha=\mathrm{d}\ln R/\mathrm{d}\theta$，$|\alpha|$ 越小表示旋臂越紧密，越大表示越开放。传统研究多对星系图像做二维傅里叶变换（2D-FT），提取主导方位角模式 $m$ 并拟合单一全局 pitch angle；但真实旋臂常有径向变化、臂间羽状结构（feathers）和多尺度子结构，因此需要空间分辨的局部测量。近红外 NIRCam 主要追踪恒星骨架并受尘埃消光影响较小，中红外 MIRI 则对尘埃发射和臂间尘埃结构更敏感，两者结合可同时刻画大尺度旋臂与精细含尘子结构。局部 pitch angle 因而成为联系旋臂形态、密度波传播、剪切和星系动力学环境的重要观测量。
contribution: 本文对七个近邻盘主导星系中的旋臂与臂间羽状子结构开展空间分辨研究。每星系使用八幅 JWST 图像（四个 NIRCam 与四个 MIRI 滤光片），将二维傅里叶变换（2D-FT）与圆窗相关法结合，同时测量全局与局部 pitch angle。2D-FT 用于识别主导方位角模式及相应的 $p_{\rm max}$，据此重建旋臂图样并定义臂/臂间掩膜；随后在 $(\ln(R),\theta)$ 平面施加不同 pitch angle 与窗口尺寸的余弦滤波，绘制多空间尺度上的 pitch-angle 分布。NIRCam 图像对主旋臂给出最稳健的测量，而 MIRI 数据在最小窗口 $D_w=0.25$ 下以更高对比度揭示含尘臂间结构，尤其是 feathers。样本中主旋臂通常为 $|\alpha|\simeq15^\circ$--$30^\circ$，feathers 则系统性更大，常超过 $50^\circ$。这些结果表明 **pitch angle 具有尺度依赖性，同一星系内不同结构组分可占据不同的角度区间**；**NIRCam 与 MIRI 因而提供互补的旋臂视图：前者追踪大尺度恒星骨架，后者显露更精细的尘埃子结构**。结合对棒旋星系的姊妹研究，本文为利用局部 pitch angle 探讨近邻星系中不同动力学环境提供了统一框架。
summary: We present a spatially resolved study of spiral arms and feather substructures in seven nearby galaxies observed with JWST. Using eight images per galaxy, from four NIRCam and four MIRI filters, we combine a two-dimensional Fourier transform (2D-FT) with a circular-window correlation method to measure both global and local pitch angles. The 2D-FT identifies the dominant azimuthal mode and the corresponding $p_{\rm max}$, allowing us to reconstruct the spiral pattern and define arm and interarm masks. We then apply cosine filters with different pitch angles and window sizes in the $(\ln (R),θ)$ plane to map the pitch-angle distribution across multiple spatial scales. NIRCam images provide the most robust measurements of the main spiral pattern, whereas MIRI data reveal dusty interarm features, particularly feathers, with greater contrast at the smallest window size ($D_w=0.25$). Across the sample, the main arms typically have $|α|\simeq15^\circ$--$30^\circ$, while feathers show systematically larger values, often above $50^\circ$. These results demonstrate that pitch angle is scale dependent and that different structural components within the same galaxy can occupy distinct angular regimes. NIRCam and MIRI therefore offer complementary views of spiral structure, with the former tracing the large-scale stellar backbone and the latter exposing finer dust substructures. Together with the companion study of barred galaxies, this work provides a common framework for using local pitch angles to investigate distinct dynamical environments in nearby galaxies.

title: Cosmic Corpses: Dead stars as Factories of the most Extreme Objects in the Universe
background_knowledge: 恒星演化终点取决于引力与物质微观物理之间的竞争。当恒星核心燃料耗尽后，白矮星主要由电子简并压支撑，其质量上限约为 $M_{\rm Ch} \approx 1.4\,M_\odot$；中子星则由中子简并压与强相互作用状态方程共同支撑，典型质量约为 $1.4\,M_\odot$、半径约为 $10\,{\rm km}$；黑洞由广义相对论描述，并具有事件视界。上述致密天体的形成、冷却、双星演化、并合与辐射，是连接量子力学、核物理和引力理论的重要研究对象。原初黑洞是另一类候选致密天体，可能起源于早期宇宙中罕见的大密度涨落，其质量可覆盖很宽的范围；若具有足够丰度，它们可充当暗物质的组成部分。该领域的研究范式包括：利用电磁观测、引力波、脉冲星计时和恒星演化模型测量质量与半径，约束物质状态方程，并通过宇宙学丰度与观测限制检验原初黑洞等暗物质候选。
contribution: 该文以教学综述的方式串联白矮星、中子星与黑洞三类恒星遗骸，说明量子力学、核相互作用与广义相对论如何共同决定它们的形成条件、内部结构与可观测性质；**其核心论点是这些致密天体的性质可由基本物理规律统一理解**。文章还讨论原初黑洞可能起源于早期宇宙中罕见的大密度涨落，并**指出它们有潜力成为暗物质的组成部分**。
summary: The apparent serenity of the night sky conceals a long history of stellar evolution, in which gravity and the properties of matter determine the remarkable fates of stars. In this pedagogical account, we discuss white dwarfs, neutron stars, and black holes, explaining how quantum mechanics, nuclear interactions, and General Relativity govern their formation and distinctive properties. We also highlight the possibility of primordial black holes, which may have formed from rare large density fluctuations in the early Universe, and briefly discuss their potential role as constituents of dark matter.

title: Dust in cold and warm dark matter in a suite of zoom-in simulations of Milky Way analogues
background_knowledge: 在宇宙学标准图景中，暗物质通过引力主导结构形成。冷暗物质（CDM）在小尺度上成团性较强；温暗物质（WDM）则因粒子自由流效应抑制小尺度功率，从而可能改变低质量暗晕、卫星星系及星系内气体与恒星的性质。利用银河系类星系的高分辨率流体 zoom-in 模拟，是检验这一差异的重要研究范式：在给定宇宙学初扰动下引入气体冷却、恒星形成、反馈和金属增丰等重子物理，比较不同暗物质模型下暗晕、恒星和星际介质的统计性质。尘埃由超新星和渐近巨星支星产生，并可在冷星际介质中通过吸积与凝聚增长；其含量受金属丰度、恒星形成历史、气体密度和反馈影响，常用尘埃-金属比（DTM）、尘埃-恒星质量比以及尘埃-恒星形成率关系等标度关系描述。若这些尘埃性质对暗物质的小尺度成团性敏感，就可能成为区分暗物质模型的观测探针，但暗晕之间的差异和重子反馈会带来显著散射。
contribution: 论文基于一组银河系类比天体的高分辨率流体 zoom-in 模拟，系统比较 CDM 与 3.5 keV WDM：采用 24 个对照模拟组成的样本，主要以尘埃-金属比（DTM）对模拟中的尘埃进行后处理，并探索替代尘埃产生方法，以检验尘埃性质能否用于反推暗物质模型。结果显示，**CDM 样本的尘埃质量总体高于 WDM，在 $z=0$ 时中位增幅为 6.6%，并在 $z\approx 0.25$ 处达到约 25% 的峰值中位差异**；两种样本的尘埃都高度集中，约 90% 位于暗晕内区，但 CDM 中略高。与以往工作不同，**Gini 系数并未稳定显示两种暗物质模型的差异，其变化主要受单个暗晕特殊结构的高敏感性驱动**。对常见尘埃标度关系的分析表明，在 $z=0$ 时，尘埃-恒星质量函数和尘埃-恒星形成率函数在两种样本间的差异在任何尘埃产生机制下都不具统计显著性；但在尘埃质量差异最大的红移，替代尘埃产生方法在总质量和标度关系上表现出更大的 CDM 与 WDM 样本分离。
summary: We use a suite of hydrodynamical zoom-in simulations of Milky Way analogues to investigate how previously identified trends in dust properties of galaxies can be utilised to infer the underlying dark matter model. We use a sample of 24 comparison simulations comparing a cold dark matter (CDM) and 3.5 keV warm dark matter (WDM) particle, primarily using a dust-to-metals (DTM) ratio to post-process the dust in the simulation, with alternative methods explored. We find a preference for higher dust masses in CDM over WDM, with a median increase of 6.6 per cent in the CDM sample at redshift $z=0$, and with a peak median difference of 25 per cent at $z\approx0.25$. Both CDM and WDM samples are highly concentrated, with approximately 90 per cent of the dust located in the inner region of the halo, though slightly higher in CDM. Contrary to previous work, we find that the Gini coefficient does not consistently show a difference in comparisons of dark matter models, with differences primarily driven by high sensitivity to the unique structure of individual haloes. Finally, we conduct an analysis of some common dust scaling relations, finding that the differences between the two samples in the dust-to-stellar mass and dust-to-SFR functions do not constitute a statistically significant difference at $z=0$ with any dust production mechanism. However, at redshifts where the difference in dust mass is greatest, the alternative dust production methods show larger separations between CDM and WDM samples in total mass and scaling relations.

title: BAO and Type Ia Supernovae in LTB Cosmology: Constraints on Radial Inhomogeneity and Acoustic-Ruler Evolution
background_knowledge: 现代标准宇宙学以宇宙学原理为基础，用均匀各向同性的 Friedmann-Robertson-Walker（FRW）度规描述膨胀历史，并用物质、辐射、空间曲率与宇宙学常数（或暗能量）解释距离与红移关系。重子声学振荡（BAO）是早期宇宙重子—光子等离子体中声波留下的特征尺度，可作为标准尺；其在星系分布中的角向或横向、以及径向相关结构分别测量角直径距离和哈勃参数。Ia 型超新星经光变曲线标准化后作为相对标准烛光，给出光度距离。二者联合可检验膨胀历史、空间曲率与暗能量性质。Lemaître-Tolman-Bondi（LTB）度规则放弃严格空间均匀性，允许仅随径向变化的密度轮廓；低密度局域空洞可通过表观加速模拟暗能量效应，但也会改变距离、红移漂移以及声学标尺在径向和横向的拉伸。该子领域的研究范式是把几何、距离与标准尺/标准烛光观测量在精确非线性模型中正演，并用协方差与模型比较评估均匀宇宙假设是否足够。
contribution: 论文把均匀 FRW 框架下的 BAO 与超新星检验推广到含宇宙学常数的 LTB 宇宙：除距离外，还需计算同一初始标尺在径向与横向上的不等拉伸；横向 BAO 与超新星联合可在无绝对校准条件下分离相对标尺演化，径向 BAO 提供互补约束。作者将检验连接到低密度区域由周围超密物质补偿的精确非线性模型，并改变低密度区的深度、宽度、相对观测者距离和背景物质密度。使用 DESI DR2 BAO 与 DES-Dovekie 超新星数据，并在完整协方差和相同校准自由度下拟合，**含三个额外参数的 LTB 模型相对平坦 $ \Lambda\mathrm{CDM} $ 使 $ \chi^2 $ 改善 8.523，且改善主要来自超新星**。**DESI 数据强烈排除仅由超新星和角向 BAO 偏好的特定深密度轮廓**；然而，**靠近观测者的窄凹陷与更远、更宽且更浅的凹陷拟合几乎相同，$ \Delta\chi^2 = 0.647 $**。因此，**联合数据能够限制特定几何，却不能唯一重建密度轮廓或声学标尺演化**。该推断仍受超新星样本选择影响，并依赖于把公布的 BAO 汇总量解释为有效红移处的局域标尺输运。**均匀模拟表明，上述拟合改善不足以确立对非均匀性的探测**。最后，在局域近似下，**共同的 LTB 标尺演化会同时移动角向 BAO 与三维 BAO 的横向分量，因而其本身不能解释二者之间的差异**。
summary: We investigate how baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) and Type Ia supernovae constrain radial density profiles and acoustic-ruler evolution in Lemaitre-Tolman-Bondi (LTB) cosmology with a cosmological constant. Extending a homogeneous Friedmann-Robertson-Walker analysis requires calculating both distances and unequal radial and transverse stretching of a single initial ruler. Combining transverse BAO with supernovae isolates relative ruler evolution without an absolute calibration, while radial BAO supplies complementary information. We connect this test to exact nonlinear models with a low-density region compensated by surrounding excess matter, varying its depth, width, distance from the observer, and background matter density. Using DESI DR2 BAO and DES-Dovekie supernovae with full covariance and identical calibration freedom, the LTB fit improves $χ^2$ by 8.523 over flat $Λ$CDM for three additional parameters, mainly through the supernovae. DESI strongly rejects the particular deep profile favored by supernovae and angular BAO alone. However, a narrow depression near the observer and a broader, shallower depression farther away fit almost equally well, with $Δχ^2=0.647$. The combined data therefore constrain particular geometries without uniquely reconstructing the density profile or ruler evolution. The inference is conditional on supernova selection and interpreting released BAO summaries through local ruler transport at effective redshifts. Homogeneous simulations show that the fit improvement does not establish a detection of inhomogeneity. Finally, in the local approximation, common LTB ruler evolution shifts angular BAO and the transverse component of three-dimensional BAO together and cannot alone explain their discrepancy.

title: CMB Bounds on Primordial Black Holes via Radiation Capture: Linear Perturbations
background_knowledge:
宇宙微波背景（CMB）是大爆炸后约 38 万年复合时期释放的辐射，其温度与偏振各向异性记录了从早期宇宙扰动到复合前等离子体演化的信息。在标准宇宙学中，复合前的光子与重子通过电磁相互作用紧密耦合，形成光子-重子流体并产生声波振荡；暗物质通过引力主导势阱，而超相对论中微子近似自由流动。线性扰动理论将时空度规以及各物质组分的密度、速度等微小偏离按傅里叶模式演化，连续性方程与 Euler 方程分别体现能量守恒和动量守恒；若不同组分之间存在额外能量-动量交换，这些方程会出现源项，进而改变 CMB 各向异性。
\n原初黑洞（PBHs）是早期宇宙密度扰动坍缩形成的黑洞候选，其丰度通常用相对暗物质的比例 $f_{\rm pbh}=\Omega_{\rm PBH}/\Omega_{\rm DM}$ 表示。若 PBHs 在辐射主导时期已经存在并浸没于宇宙辐射背景中，它们可通过引力捕获光子与超相对论中微子，形成有效的辐射能量-动量转移。这种相互作用不仅影响背景膨胀历史，也会在线性阶影响辐射扰动的演化。由于 CMB 对复合前的能量注入、辐射密度与扰动演化高度敏感，温度与偏振功率谱可用于限制 PBHs 的丰度及其质量依赖。该方向连接早期宇宙、引力物理与暗物质候选，是用 CMB 检验原初黑洞与基础物理的重要研究范式。
contribution: 论文研究原初辐射（光子与超相对论中微子）和原初黑洞之间的引力相互作用，及其在 CMB 各向异性中的印记。作者假设 PBHs 浸没在宇宙辐射背景中，引入协变能量-动量转移四维矢量描述 PBHs 对辐射的引力捕获；在 M. Farhang 与 S. M. S. Movahed [Phys. Rev. D 114, 083533 (2026)] 的背景层面框架基础上，将分析推广到线性阶非均匀宇宙，并一致地修改扰动的连续性方程与 Euler 方程，以纳入能量和动量转移。利用该相互作用在 CMB 中的印记，作者给出对 PBH 丰度 $f_{\rm pbh}$ 的新限制，发现**这些限制比仅用背景演化的分析最多严格两个数量级，并强烈依赖于 PBH 质量**。采用 Planck 温度与偏振数据，对 $M$ 在 $10^{15}-10^{17}M_{\odot}$ 范围得到 **$f_{\rm pbh}\lesssim 0.05-0.002$**；进一步对 $\ell_{\rm max}=7000$ 的宇宙方差极限巡天做灵敏度预报（取基准 $f_{\rm pbh}=0$），在 $10^{13}-10^{17}M_{\odot}$ 质量范围预计可达 **$f_{\rm pbh}\lesssim 10^{-2}-2\times10^{-4}$**。
summary: We investigate the gravitational interaction between primordial radiation, consisting of photons and ultra-relativistic neutrinos, and primordial black holes (PBHs), and study its imprint on the anisotropies of the cosmic microwave background (CMB). Assuming that PBHs are immersed in the cosmic radiation background, we introduce a covariant energy-momentum transfer four-vector to describe the gravitational capture of radiation by PBHs. We extend the background-level framework of M. Farhang and S. M. S. Movahed [Phys. Rev. D 114, 083533 (2026)] to an inhomogeneous Universe at linear order by consistently modifying the perturbed continuity and Euler equations to account for both energy and momentum transfer. We use the imprint of this interaction on the CMB to place novel constraints on the PBH abundance, $f_{\rm pbh}$. We show that these constraints are up to two orders of magnitude tighter than those obtained from background-only analyses and exhibit a strong dependence on the PBH mass. Using Planck temperature and polarization data, we constrain the PBH fraction to $f_{\rm pbh} \lesssim 0.05-0.002$ for $M$ in the range $10^{15}-10^{17} M_\odot$. Furthermore, sensitivity forecasts for a cosmic-variance-limited survey with $\ell_{\rm max}=7000$, assuming a fiducial $f_{\rm pbh}=0$, yield projected bounds of $f_{\rm pbh} \lesssim 10^{-2}-2\times 10^{-4}$ over the mass range $10^{13}-10^{17} M_\odot$.

title: Forward modeling linear variable filter data: High resolution PAH and Paschen-$α$ maps from SPHEREx
background_knowledge: 星际介质中的多环芳烃（PAH）在近红外 3.3 μm、3.4 μm 等波段具有显著发射特征，是探测电离状态、辐射场、金属丰度、成分以及湍流和恒星反馈塑造的 ISM 结构的重要示踪物。传统宽波段测光（如 WISE，$R \sim 2$）难以分离这些窄发射线；SPHEREx 利用线性可变滤光片（LVF）进行近红外光谱成像巡天，提供 $R \sim 35$ 的低分辨率光谱，使全天 PAH 与复合线制图成为可能。此类数据的主要方法挑战是：LVF 的空间-波长采样随位置变化，若简单转为常规波段平均图，易在发射线处产生条纹伪影。前向建模、像素级数据组织和缺失数据插补是获得干净高分辨率发射线图的关键技术背景。
contribution: 论文提出一种可扩展的前向建模方法，将 SPHEREx LVF 数据重排为像素级数据库，掩模恒星污染，并用条件化、数据驱动的各向异性高斯过程对缺失像素进行插补，从而生成具有 $8.5\ \mathrm{arcsec}$ FWHM 角分辨率（$6.4\ \mathrm{arcsec}$ 像素）的高质量全天 SPHEREx 发射线图，且**自然避免可见条纹伪影**。作者将该方法应用于 Rosette nebula、Corona Australis molecular cloud、M33 和 M31 等覆盖不同银河系与河外条件的区域，得到 $3.3\ \mu\mathrm{m}$、$3.4\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ 的 PAH 以及 Paschen-$\alpha$ 发射图；与其它气体和尘埃示踪图比较展示了 SPHEREx $3.3\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ PAH 图的质量与协同性，灵敏度达到 $\sigma(I_{3.3}) = 2.7 \times 10^{-8}\ \mathrm{erg}\ \mathrm{s}^{-1}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-2}\ \mathrm{sr}^{-1}$。作者估计，若将 SPHEREx 巡天延长两年并对扫描策略作适度修改，**其全天 PAH 灵敏度可匹配或超过 WISE**。
summary: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) emission is a powerful tool for the study of the interstellar medium (ISM) in both Galactic and extragalactic contexts. It can reveal ionization state, radiation field, metallicity, composition, and ISM structure as sculpted by processes like turbulence and stellar feedback. Here we use NASA's SPHEREx to produce clean, high-resolution PAH maps at spectral resolution R $\sim$ 35 (compared to WISE at R $\sim$ 2). Prior treatments of the SPHEREx linear variable filter data seek to convert them to more conventional band-averaged maps that can leave striping artifacts associated with spatially variable wavelength sampling, especially at emission lines. In contrast, we deliver a scalable forward-modeling method capable of generating high-quality all-sky SPHEREx emission-line maps at 8.5 arcsec FWHM angular resolution (on 6.4 arcsec pixels), while naturally producing maps without visible striping. We reformat the data into a pixel-level database, mask stellar contamination, and infill missing pixels with a conditional, data-driven, anisotropic Gaussian process. We apply our method to produce 3.3 $μ$m and 3.4 $μ$m PAH and Paschen-$α$ emission maps of a set of fields spanning a range of Galactic and extragalactic conditions including the Rosette nebula, the Corona Australis molecular cloud, M33, and M31. We demonstrate the quality and synergies of our SPHEREx 3.3 $μ$m PAH maps by comparisons with other available gas and dust tracer maps and achieve sensitivities up to $σ(I_{3.3}) = 2.7 \times 10^{-8}$ erg s$^{-1}$ cm$^{-2}$ sr$^{-1}$. We estimate that a two-year extension of the SPHEREx survey, with modest modifications to the scanning strategy, would match or exceed the PAH sensitivity of WISE over the whole sky.

title: Numerical-Relativity Particle-in-Cell Simulations: Self-Gravitating Collisionless Matter in Dynamical Spacetimes
background_knowledge: 该工作属于数值相对论与无碰撞动理学交叉方向。广义相对论把引力解释为时空几何：物质与场的能量动量张量决定时空曲率，而时空演化又决定物质运动。数值相对论通过离散化 Einstein 方程，研究强引力、黑洞形成与并合等高度非线性动力学。对物质，常见近似是理想流体；但在暗物质晕、球状星团、相对论星团和部分吸积系统中，粒子间碰撞时标远长于动力学时标，需采用无碰撞动理学描述：相空间分布函数沿测地线流演化，并与自引力耦合，即 Einstein--Vlasov 系统。其数值研究需同时处理时空奇点、规范选择、自适应网格、粒子采样噪声、能量动量守恒和长时演化稳定性。PIC 方法以宏粒子采样相空间，将应力能量沉积到网格，用网格上的场推动粒子，已在相对论等离子体中得到发展；把电磁力替换为测地力，可将其推广到引力问题。
contribution: 论文**构建了三维数值相对论 particle-in-cell（NRPIC）框架，可在动态时空中自洽求解 Einstein--Vlasov 系统**。方法基于性能可移植的 AthenaK 代码，将粒子动力学与 Z4c 时空演化、moving puncture 规范耦合，并通过在自适应网格上的守恒型应力能量沉积实现自洽演化；同时借助相对论等离子体 PIC 的进展，把引力问题写成等价的电动力学形式，并设计了利用洛伦兹力形式测地力的 Boris 型粒子推进器。作者用球对称尘埃坍缩检验耦合演化，追踪长椭球坍缩经无碰撞焦散形成黑洞，并研究相对论星团的稳定性与非线性迁移。作为对数值相对论中引力不稳定性的展示，论文模拟共同无碰撞包层内两个过密区的坍缩，**跟随黑洞形成、双星旋近与并合，以及并合残余黑洞的后续质量吸积**，表明该框架可用于研究强引力下无碰撞物质的多尺度非线性动力学。
summary: Gravitational collapse and instability, black-hole dynamics in systems with large scale separations, and questions surrounding extremal black hole formation require full nonlinear studies using accurate and adapted numerical tools. To this end, we present a new algorithm to study collisionless relativistic systems using a fully kinetic description of matter coupled to the evolving spacetime. In detail, we present a numerical-relativity particle-in-cell (NRPIC) framework for solving the Einstein--Vlasov system in three spatial dimensions. Implemented on top of the performance-portable \texttt{AthenaK} code, the method couples particle dynamics to Z4c spacetime evolution in moving puncture gauge through conservative stress-energy deposition on adaptively refined meshes. Our implementation makes use of advances in the computational modeling of relativistic plasmas using modern PIC models, now made available to general-relativistic gravity via an equivalent electrodynamic formulation. We introduce a Boris-type particle pusher that exploits the electrodynamic (Lorentz force) form of the geodesic force. We validate the coupled evolution against spherical dust collapse, follow prolate collapse through collisionless caustics into black-hole formation, and investigate the stability and nonlinear migration of relativistic clusters. Highlighting its potential to study gravitational instability in NR, we simulate the collapse of two overdensities within a common collisionless envelope, following black-hole formation, binary inspiral and merger, and subsequent mass accretion onto the remnant.

title: Gravitational waves and the exit from de Sitter in Inflation without an Inflaton
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学把早期宇宙的加速膨胀（暴胀）视为解释宇宙微波背景大尺度均匀性、近标度不变原初曲率扰动以及原初引力波的关键框架。标准慢滚暴胀通常引入一个标量场（暴胀子），其势能主导近似 de Sitter 时空；暴胀子量子涨落被拉伸到视界外并冻结为曲率扰动，度规张量涨落则给出原初引力波，二者幅度之比由张量标量比 $r$ 表征。暴胀结束需平滑退出并转化为辐射（再加热），原初扰动的功率谱、谱指数 $n_s$、张量谱指数 $n_T$、非高斯性以及 $\mu$ 型谱畸变等观测量，连接 CMB、干涉仪引力波背景和轻元素丰度。Bunch-Davies 真空是 de Sitter 时空中常用的绝热真空选择，用于设定早期微扰的初始条件。IWI 属于不引入暴胀子、仅用引力自由度产生曲率扰动的替代图景：二阶 de Sitter 引力子（张量模）的梯度应力通过爱因斯坦方程作源，在视界内外演化中产生标量曲率。理解其二阶微扰论自洽性、张量源是否增强，以及退出 de Sitter 后如何把真空能转交给辐射，是检验该框架是否可观测的核心问题。
contribution: 论文研究 Inflation without an Inflaton（IWI）中二阶 de Sitter 引力子通过其梯度应力的库仑型势产生原初曲率，并完成从纯 de Sitter 到辐射主导的平滑退出计算。核心结果是：每一对引力子模式按 $(p/k)^2$ 贡献，随着参与的 e-folds 产生指数增强；在精确 Bunch-Davies 演化下，该标量解满足纯 de Sitter 中全部四个二阶标量爱因斯坦方程。对推迟横向无迹解，其 UV 核为量级一，比标量核低 $(k/p)^2$，单圈修正为 $\Delta^2_{h,2}/\Delta^2_h\simeq0.04\,\Delta^2_h$；源虽在内部冻结前起作用，但振荡相消使张量模不被增强。作者让曲率穿过平滑退出进入辐射主导，把守恒曲率置于真空衰变超曲面；用全局耗尽时钟使每个尺度在视界退出后于零剪切时间停留 $N_{\rm w}$ 个 e-folds 再局部释放，从而让所有尺度获得相同增强。能量动量守恒把耗尽的真空能注入非真空部门，并建模为辐射。深辐射主导时，$\Delta^2_\zeta=c_w\Delta_h^4e^{N_{\rm w}}/20$，其中 $c_w$ 依赖时钟，且 $n_s-1=-4\varepsilon$、$n_T=-2\varepsilon$。谱为绝热、高斯；超视界 $\zeta$ 的守恒优于 $10^{-4}$，改变绝热退出流体对其影响小于 $0.2\%$。直接辐射退出要求 $31\lesssim N_{\rm w}\lesssim50$，即 $3\times10^{-6}\lesssim r\lesssim0.036$。在干涉仪频段，$\Omega_{\rm GW}h^2\simeq2\times10^{-21}$--$3\times10^{-17}$，BBO 对 $r\gtrsim0.01$、终极 DECIGO 对 $r\gtrsim10^{-5}$ 可及；CMB B 模搜索探测 $r\gtrsim10^{-3}$。在 $k>k_{\rm end}e^{-N_{\rm w}}$ 处标量谱陡化为 $k^{-1}$，当 $N_{\rm w}\gtrsim45$ 且释放尖锐时抑制 $\mu$ 畸变。**总体而言，IWI 可给出绝热、高斯且自洽的原初曲率，并把可观测的引力波背景与退出参数 $N_{\rm w}$、$r$ 联系起来。**
summary:
In Inflation without an Inflaton (IWI), second-order de Sitter (dS) gravitons generate primordial curvature as the Coulomb-type potential of their gradient stress. Each pair contributes $(p/k)^2$, yielding exponential enhancement over the contributing e-folds. With exact Bunch-Davies evolution, this solution satisfies all four scalar second-order Einstein equations in pure dS. The retarded transverse-traceless solution instead has a UV kernel of order unity, $(k/p)^2$ below the scalar kernel, and a one-loop correction $Δ^2_{h,2}/Δ^2_h\simeq0.04\,Δ^2_h$. Its source acts before internal freeze-out, but oscillatory cancellations prevent tensor enhancement.
  We evolve the curvature through a smooth exit into radiation domination. Conserved curvature resides on the vacuum-decay hypersurface. A global depletion clock holds each scale on zero-shear time for $N_{\rm w}$ e-folds after horizon exit before local release, giving all scales equal enhancement. Energy-momentum conservation feeds the depleted vacuum energy into a non-vacuum sector, modeled as radiation. Deep in radiation domination, $Δ^2_ζ=c_wΔ_h^4e^{N_{\rm w}}/20$, with clock-dependent $c_w$, $n_s-1=-4ε$, and $n_T=-2ε$. The spectrum is adiabatic and Gaussian; super-horizon $ζ$ is conserved to better than $10^{-4}$, and changing the adiabatic exit fluid alters it by less than $0.2\%$. A direct radiation exit requires $31\lesssim N_{\rm w}\lesssim50$, or $3\times10^{-6}\lesssim r\lesssim0.036$.
  At interferometer frequencies, $Ω_{\rm GW}h^2\simeq2\times10^{-21}$--$3\times10^{-17}$, accessible to BBO for $r\gtrsim0.01$ and ultimate DECIGO for $r\gtrsim10^{-5}$; CMB B-mode searches probe $r\gtrsim10^{-3}$. Above $k_{\rm end}e^{-N_{\rm w}}$, the scalar spectrum steepens to $k^{-1}$, suppressing $μ$-distortions for sharp release when $N_{\rm w}\gtrsim45$.

title: Constraining Cosmic Deceleration using the Solar System
background_knowledge:
现代宇宙学把宇宙膨胀描述为尺度因子 $a(t)$ 的演化，其加速度由减速参数 $q_0 \equiv -\frac{a\ddot a}{\dot a^2}$（取当今时刻）刻画；$q_0<0$ 表示加速膨胀。标准 ΛCDM 模型中 $q_0=\Omega_m/2-\Omega_\Lambda$，观测倾向于 $q_0\approx -0.55$。1998 年 Ia 型超新星测距发现宇宙加速，此后宇宙微波背景辐射、重子声学振荡（BAO）、弱引力透镜与哈勃常数测量共同构建了宇宙膨胀史的研究范式。
\n传统宇宙学探针依赖遥远天体的距离、红移与结构生长，而太阳系检验提供了完全不同的实验室。在行星、海王星外天体与奥尔特云等引力束缚系统中，宇宙膨胀不会像拉开自由粒子那样直接拉开轨道；但若把宇宙加速视为相对局部惯性系的极微弱径向扰动，它可在轨道运动中留下可计算的印记。本文的唯象图像是把宇宙加速对应为一个弱的 Hooke 型径向微扰，其加速度量级可写成 $\sim q_0 H_0^2 r$，在太阳系尺度上远小于太阳引力，却可能通过精密轨道测量累积体现。
\n该方向的检验范式属于太阳系引力实验与天体测量的交叉：利用行星近日点进动、行星历表、月球激光测距、海王星外天体及长周期彗星轨道，将观测与包含微小径向扰动的开普勒或 N 体模型比对，从而限制 $q_0$ 等宇宙学参数。其优势是距离尺度、系统误差与宇宙学探针相对独立；劣势是信号极弱、对轨道初值、非引力摄动和模型假设高度敏感，因此需要误差传播与敏感性分析来评估稳健性。
contribution: 本文研究太阳系动力学能否对当前宇宙减速参数 $q_0$ 给出独立限制，从而为常规宇宙学探针提供互补途径。作者把宇宙加速与一个弱的 Hooke 型径向微扰联系起来，分别利用行星近日点进动、海王星外天体（TNOs）和奥尔特云动力学推导 $q_0$ 的界限。行星数据给出较稳健的限制 **$|q_0|\lesssim 10^9$**；外太阳系可给出更强但更依赖模型的限制，接近 **$10^5$**。文中通过 Monte Carlo 误差传播和敏感性分析考察这些估计的统计稳健性及其对轨道测量的依赖，并进一步表明未来高精度天体测量与外行星任务有望将限制改善若干数量级，从而把 **太阳系动力学确立为探测宇宙加速的互补实验室**。
summary: We investigate whether Solar System dynamics can provide independent constraints on the present day cosmological deceleration parameter $q_0$, offering a complementary approach to conventional cosmological probes. By relating cosmic acceleration to a weak Hooke type radial perturbation, we derive bounds using planetary perihelion precession, trans-Neptunian objects, and Oort cloud dynamics. We obtain relatively robust planetary bounds of $|q_0|\lesssim 10^9$, while the outer Solar System yields potentially stronger, albeit more model dependent, constraints approaching $10^5$. Through Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analyses, we explore the statistical robustness of these estimates and their dependence on orbital measurements. Finally, we demonstrate how future precision astrometry and outer planet missions could improve these limits by several orders of magnitude, establishing Solar System dynamics as a complementary laboratory for probing cosmological acceleration.

title: Particle Swarm Optimization Strategies for Lensed Gravitational Waves: Parameter Estimation, Source Classification, and Accelerated Sampling
background_knowledge: 引力透镜是强引力场使光线或引力波传播路径发生偏折的观测效应。对于致密双星并合产生的引力波，若信号路径经过星系或星系团等大质量前景天体，就可能形成强透镜效应，产生多个到达时间、放大率和相位不同的“像”。当这些像的时间延迟短于信号持续时间时，探测器会接收到相互重叠的透镜引力波信号，其波形相当于原始波形与透镜响应的卷积，并引入额外的透镜参数。此类搜索需要在较高维参数空间中同时拟合源参数与透镜参数，后验分布常呈多峰、强非线性结构，传统网格搜索和局部优化容易陷入局部极值；贝叶斯参数估计通常依赖嵌套采样等方法，计算成本较高。粒子群优化（PSO）是一类基于群体协作的全局优化算法，可在复杂、多峰参数空间中高效探索，因此被用于透镜引力波搜索、参数估计、信号分类以及为贝叶斯采样构造先验。
contribution: 本文将粒子群优化（PSO）系统应用于四探测器相干网络中的透镜致密双星并合引力波搜索、参数估计与分类。研究采用限制性 2-PN 波形作为模板，并使用模型无关的双像透镜参数化，同时评估 PSO 在模板匹配的 2-PN 信号与模板失配的 IMRPhenomD 信号上的表现。结果表明，在 2-PN 情形下可有效恢复啁啾质量 $\mathcal{M}_c$、质量比 $q$、天区位置和透镜参数；在波形失配时则出现质量参数偏差。本文构建了结合 12 次 PSO 运行、多数投票与通量比阈值的三分类流程，在区分透镜引力波、未透镜引力波与噪声时达到 **86.19% 的准确率**。作者进一步提出 PSO_GAUSS_MIX 方法，利用 PSO 估计构造高斯混合先验并供嵌套采样使用，在限制性 2-PN 情形下取得 **1.38 倍加速**且保持后验精度。这些结果确立了 PSO 作为透镜引力波搜索高效优化器及贝叶斯参数估计有效先验构造工具的地位。
summary: The detection and parameter estimation of lensed gravitational wave (GW) signals are crucial for astrophysics and cosmology. Strong lensing introduces extra parameters, rendering the search high-dimensional, multi-modal, and strongly nonlinear. We apply Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to the search, parameter estimation, and classification of lensed compact binary coalescence GWs within a four-detector coherent network. Using the restricted 2-PN waveform as a template and a model-independent double-image lens parameterization, we assess PSO on both model-matched 2-PN signals and template-mismatched IMRPhenomD signals. Results show effective recovery of chirp mass, mass ratio, sky location, and lens parameters in the 2-PN case, with mass biases appearing under waveform mismatch. A three-class classification pipeline combining 12 PSO runs, majority voting, and a flux ratio threshold achieves 86.19% accuracy in distinguishing lensed GWs, unlensed GWs, and noise. We further propose PSO_GAUSS_MIX method, which constructs a Gaussian mixture prior from PSO estimates for nested sampling, yielding speedups of 1.38x in the restricted 2-PN cases while preserving posterior accuracy. These results establish PSO as an efficient optimizer for lensed GW searches and an effective prior constructor for Bayesian parameter estimation.

title: Impact of the large scale environment on the baryonic scaling relations of disc galaxies: Insights from the GASP survey
background_knowledge: 盘星系的结构、运动学和重子含量之间存在紧密的经验标度关系，其中最著名的是 Tully--Fisher 关系（TFR）和比角动量--质量关系（SAMR）。TFR 将盘星系的重子质量（或恒星质量、光度）与其旋转速度联系起来，反映星系引力势阱与重子聚集之间的平衡；SAMR 则将比角动量 $ j = J/M $ 与质量联系起来，其斜率接近潮汐力矩理论预言的约 $ 2/3 $。这些关系之所以重要，是因为任何移除重子、改变其运动学或扰动盘的过程，都可能在关系中出现偏离或增大弥散。星系所在的大尺度环境——从孤立场星系到星系群和星系团——会通过冲压剥离（ram pressure stripping）、strangulation、harassment、并合和前处理等过程影响盘星系。特别是在星系团中，星系以高速穿过热团内介质，外部气压可剥离其冷气体，改变恒星形成和气体含量。GASP（GAs Stripping Phenomena in galaxies）正是利用 MUSE 积分场光谱，在 $ z \approx 0.05 $ 处系统研究场、群、团星系及不同冲压剥离阶段的盘星系样本，以检验环境对重子标度关系的影响。
contribution: 论文利用 GASP/MUSE 样本中 81 个具有有利倾角的盘星系，测量恒星与电离气体的分布、运动学及比角动量，并检验 TFR 与 SAMR 是否随大尺度环境变化。**在弥散范围内，恒星和重子标度关系没有显示出显著的环境依赖**：对任一种运动学示踪物，TFR 斜率约为 $ \alpha \approx 3.6 $ 和 $ \approx 3.5 $；SAMR 斜率约为 $ \alpha \approx 0.65 $--$ 0.75 $，与潮汐力矩理论的预言一致。样本中的 10 个 S0-S0/as 星系也符合这一图像，支持“褪色旋涡星系”（faded spiral）形成情景。**唯一明显的环境信号出现在气体 SAMR 中：经历冲压剥离的星系比未受扰动星系低约 $ 0.16 $ dex**。作者指出，这一偏移主要源于其增强的恒星形成率，以及由此通过 Schmidt--Kennicutt 定律推断出的更高气体质量，而不是运动学扰动或盘截断。结果表明，在 MUSE 所探测的区域（$ \lesssim 6 $ 个盘标长）内，这些盘星系不仅从星系团过程和纤维状结构中的前处理中，而且从任何环境中都存在的并合与喷射反馈中，保留了形成时获得的角动量。
summary: The Tully--Fisher relation (TFR) and the specific angular momentum--mass relation (SAMR) link the baryonic content of a disc to its kinematics and dynamics. Hence, these scaling relations should bear the imprints of any process removing baryons or altering their kinematics, such as those acting in clusters of galaxies. We test this using the MUSE survey "GAs Stripping Phenomena in galaxies" (GASP), which targets field, group, and cluster members at $z \approx 0.05$ and various stages of ram pressure stripping. For the 81 discs with favourable inclinations, we measure the distribution and kinematics of stars and ionised gas, and their specific angular momenta. Within their scatter, the stellar and baryonic relations show no significant dependence on the large scale environment: the TFRs have slopes $α\approx 3.6$ and $\approx 3.5$ for any kinematic tracer, and the SAMRs have $α\approx 0.65$--$0.75$, as predicted by tidal torque theory. The same holds for the ten S0-S0/as in our sample, consistent with the "faded spiral" formation scenario. Only the gas SAMR shows an environmental signature, with ram pressure stripped galaxies lying $\approx 0.16$~dex below unperturbed ones. This offset is mostly due to their enhanced star formation rate, and thus higher gas mass when inferred through the Schmidt-Kennicutt law, rather than to kinematic perturbations or disc truncation. Our results suggest that, within the area probed by MUSE ($\lesssim6$ disc scale lengths), these discs have preserved the angular momentum acquired at formation not only from cluster processes and pre-processing in filaments, but also from mergers and ejective feedback acting in any environment.

title: Studying the Fullerene Nest: JWST Observations of the Planetary Nebula Tc 1. II. A Spectroscopic and Spatial Study of C$_{60}$ and C$_{70}$ Emission
background_knowledge:
行星状星云（planetary nebula, PN）是一类恒星演化末期的天体，由质量约为 $0.8$–$8\,M_\odot$ 的恒星产生。这类恒星在渐近巨星分支（AGB）阶段经历强烈的脉动与星风质量损失，抛射出富碳或富氧的包层；之后，它暴露出的高温核心（$T_{\rm eff}\gtrsim 3\times10^{4}$ K）会电离这些抛射物，从而形成光学波段可见的发射线星云，并伴随来自星周尘埃与分子的红外辐射。当恒星大气中碳氧比 C/O $>1$（即碳星情形）时，氧被 CO 分子几乎全部锁定，剩余的碳便可用于形成碳尘、多环芳香烃（PAH）以及富勒烯等复杂碳分子，因此行星状星云是研究碳化学与尘埃形成的关键实验室。
\n富勒烯是由碳原子构成的封闭笼状分子，其中最对称的 C$_{60}$ 呈足球状，还有对称性更低的 C$_{70}$ 等。它们具有红外活性的振动模式：C$_{60}$ 的四个 $F_{1u}$ 模式分别落在约 $7.0$、$8.5$、$17.4$ 和 $18.9\,\mu$m，其中 $7.0\,\mu$m 主要对应 C–C 伸缩振动，$17.4$ 与 $18.9\,\mu$m 对应较低的径向与切向振动；C$_{70}$ 因对称性更低而拥有更多红外活性模式。2010 年，Spitzer 红外光谱在行星状星云 Tc 1 中首次于天文环境中探测到 C$_{60}$ 与 C$_{70}$，这也是首次在太空中确认这类分子。此后，一个核心问题是：这些富勒烯究竟以气相分子形式存在，还是以固态（尘埃）形式凝聚？它们占多大的碳预算？形成与激发机制是什么？
\n在观测手段上，红外振动光谱是识别与诊断富勒烯的主要途径。谱带的中心波长、轮廓形状（是否含有振转结构）以及不同谱带之间的强度比，都携带激发温度、光深与分子所处物相的信息；不过，在低光谱分辨率下，富勒烯宽谱带容易与原子的精细结构发射线（例如 [Ne II]、[S IV] 等）混叠，使带比测量存在系统偏差。詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）搭载的中红外仪器 MIRI 配备积分场光谱仪 MRS，可在 $5$–$28\,\mu$m 提供 $R\sim 1500$–$3500$ 的中高分辨率光谱，并同时给出空间分辨的光谱数据立方体，从而首次能够在空间与速度两个维度上，把富勒烯谱带与原子发射线分开，并研究其空间分布。
contribution:
本文基于 JWST MIRI/MRS 对行星状星云 Tc 1 的积分场光谱观测，对其中性 C$_{60}$ 与 C$_{70}$ 富勒烯发射带进行了迄今最精细的光谱与空间分析。
\n主要结果包括：

1. **首次将富勒烯谱带与原子发射线在光谱上干净分离**，从而更准确地刻画谱带轮廓（band profile），并给出比以往观测更可靠的带比。观测显示，富勒烯发射合计约占总红外输出的 $\sim 2.6\%$，据此推算 **约 $0.6\%$ 的碳预算被锁定在富勒烯中**。

2. 光谱中**没有发现 C$_{60}^{+}$、C$_{70}^{+}$ 或 C$_{60}^{-}$ 的明确证据**，即观测到的富勒烯主要以中性形式存在。

3. 在全部空间像素上，单个 C$_{60}$ 与 C$_{70}$ 谱带的轮廓形状**没有明显的空间变化**；$17.4$ 与 $18.9\,\mu$m 的 C$_{60}$ 带显示出清晰可分辨的振转结构，$12.5$、$14.8$、$17.7$ 与 $21.8\,\mu$m 的 C$_{70}$ 带也呈现类似结构，**这进一步确认所有发射富勒烯分子均处于气相**。

4. 本文测得 $7.0/18.9\,\mu$m 的 C$_{60}$ 带比约为 $1.4$–$1.9$，**高于此前报道的 $\sim 1.3$**；同时指出，除 $8.5\,\mu$m 带外，**所有谱带都含有 C$_{70}$ 的显著贡献**，这使得谱带分析更为复杂。

5. 在空间上，**富勒烯发射集中于距中心星 $5$–$6$ 角秒处的一条薄而非对称的壳层**，该壳层位于星云核心的外缘；这一核心是 $\gtrsim 4000$ 年前一次短暂的单次抛射事件所形成的。
summary: We present a detailed analysis of the fullerene emission bands in JWST MIRI/MRS observations of the planetary nebula Tc 1. The observations reveal the emission features due to neutral C$_{60}$ and C$_{70}$ in unprecedented detail. The combined fullerene emission represents $\sim$2.6% of the total infrared output, suggesting that $\sim$0.6% of the carbon budget is locked up in fullerenes. We find no clear evidence for C$_{60}^+$, C$_{70}^+$ or C$_{60}^-$ in the spectrum. The high spectral resolution allows us to separate the fullerene bands from atomic emission lines for the first time, allowing for a much better characterization of the band profiles and yielding more accurate band ratios than previous observations.
